info.title: Upload-Post API
info.description: Upload-Post is a unified social media API that allows you to upload videos, photos, text, and documents to 22 social media platforms (TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook, X/Twitter, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, Reddit, Discord, Telegram, WordPress and more) with a single API call. Features include scheduling, queue system, async uploads, FFmpeg media processing, analytics, webhooks, and white-label user management.

tags.name: Telegram
tags.description: Telegram through your own bot: chat data and analytics, Stars and payments, chat management, bot profile, commands and sticker sets, updates and direct messages.

tags.name: Content Upload
tags.description: Upload video, photo, text, and document content to social media platforms.

tags.name: Upload Management
tags.description: Check upload status, view history, and manage scheduled posts.

tags.name: Queue System
tags.description: Configure and preview the automatic post queue.

tags.name: Platform Integration
tags.description: Retrieve platform-specific data: Facebook pages, LinkedIn pages, Pinterest boards, Reddit posts, and analytics.

tags.name: User Management
tags.description: Create, list, get, and delete user profiles.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Verify API keys, generate and validate JWT tokens for white-label integration.

tags.name: FFmpeg Editor
tags.description: Process and transform media using FFmpeg commands on Upload-Post infrastructure.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Configure real-time webhook and Telegram notifications for upload events.

tags.name: Instagram Interactions
tags.description: Retrieve Instagram media, comments, conversations, and send direct messages or private replies.

tags.name: Bluesky
tags.description: Bluesky reads (read-only XRPC gateway, post engagement, profiles, search, followers) and notifications; actions, profile, graph, moderation and drafts. Likes, reposts, follows and list additions share daily limits per Bluesky account (200), per Upload-Post account and app-wide (Bluesky Developer Guidelines); reports, 20 per account per day. Repeating the same action within a short window returns the first answer (replayed: true).

tags.name: Teams and Approvals
tags.description: Team roles, post approval queue, end-client approval and the team activity log. Members call the API with their own credentials plus `X-Act-As-User: <owner email>`.

tags.name: Feedback
tags.description: Report an unclear error, a doc that does not match, a bug or a missing feature to the Upload-Post team.

tags.name: Google Business
tags.description: Google Business Profile: locations, reviews, posts, media, verification, attributes, menus, services, lodging, place actions, performance and account administration. Some writes are switched off or need confirm: true (see each operation).

tags.name: ChatGPT Ads
tags.description: Ads in ChatGPT through the customer's own OpenAI ad account: accounts, campaigns, ad groups, ads, creatives, insights and one-call promote.

tags.name: Meta Ads
tags.description: Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ads through the customer's own ad account: connect, promote existing posts, campaigns, ad sets, creatives, ads, insights with breakdowns and audiences. Not generally available yet (waiting for Meta's App Review).

tags.name: X
tags.description: X (Twitter) reads and actions beyond publishing: mentions of the whole account, search, counts, likers, reposters, quotes, bookmarks, followers, lists, trends and post analytics, plus unrepost, bookmarks, hidden replies and lists. X bills every resource a read returns (post $0.005, user $0.010, list $0.005, follower $0.010; trends $0.010 per request), so every read is on demand, cached, and counted against a daily X spend per Upload-Post account and app-wide; each response carries a `billing` estimate. Endpoints that need an X permission the account did not grant answer `403` `x_reconnect_required` with the `scope`: reconnect X to grant it.

tags.name: Pinterest
tags.description: Pinterest API v5 beyond publishing, through one gateway that mirrors Pinterest's own paths: account and Pin analytics with any date range and breakdown, top Pins and top video Pins, trends, boards and sections (update, delete, list their Pins), search of own Pins and boards, followers and following, website verification, product tags, catalogs and the endpoints Pinterest has in beta (edit a Pin, analytics of up to 100 Pins).

tags.name: TikTok Ads
tags.description: TikTok ads through the customer's own TikTok ad account (Marketing API): connection, Spark Ads to promote an existing post, campaigns, ad groups, ads, creatives, audiences and reports. Spend runs on the customer's ad account; Upload-Post never charges it. Not generally available yet.

post.description: Upload a video to one or more social media platforms. Supports TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook, X (Twitter), Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, Reddit, Discord, and Telegram. Supports immediate, async, scheduled, and queued uploads.

paid_partnership.description: [All] Marks the post as sponsored / paid partnership. Mapped to TikTok brand_content_toggle, YouTube hasPaidProductPlacement and X paid_partnership; Facebook and Pinterest also need the sponsor id. Networks without a native label publish without it and get a warning. Network-specific fields win. On TikTok it is not allowed with privacy_level=SELF_ONLY (400 commercial_disclosure_privacy_conflict) and drafts do not carry it. See https://docs.upload-post.com/guides/paid-partnership

x_paid_partnership.description: [X] Paid partnership disclosure on the first post. Wins over paid_partnership.

facebook_sponsor_id.description: [Facebook] Sponsor's Page id for the branded content tag (sponsor_id). Page photos, Page videos (facebook_media_type=VIDEO) and text posts; not Reels or Stories.

pinterest_sponsor_id.description: [Pinterest] Sponsor account id for the paid partnership label (sponsor_id). Pinterest closed beta only.

disclose_commercial.description: [TikTok] Disclose post content switch. With true, send your_brand and/or branded_content.

your_brand.description: [TikTok] With disclose_commercial: promoting your own business.

branded_content.description: [TikTok] With disclose_commercial: paid partnership with a third-party brand. With privacy_level=SELF_ONLY the post is published as PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE.

video.description: The video file to upload (binary file) or a public video URL.

title.description: Default title/caption of the video. Required for YouTube and Reddit; optional for all other platforms. Platform-specific titles override this.

description.description: Optional extended text used on LinkedIn commentary, Facebook descriptions, YouTube descriptions, and Pinterest notes. Ignored elsewhere, except on TikTok when there is no `tiktok_title`, `title` or `tiktok_description`: then it is the TikTok caption.

scheduled_date.description: ISO-8601 date/time to schedule publishing (e.g., '2025-12-31T23:45:00Z'). Must be in the future (≤365 days). Omit for immediate upload. Cannot be used with `add_to_queue`.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier (e.g., 'Europe/Madrid', 'America/New_York'). If provided, `scheduled_date` is interpreted in this timezone. Defaults to UTC.

async_upload.description: If true, returns immediately with a `request_id` and processes in the background. If false but upload takes >59s, automatically switches to async.

add_to_queue.description: If true, automatically schedules the post to the next available queue slot. Cannot be used with `scheduled_date`.

first_comment.description: Automatically post a first comment after publishing. Supported on Instagram, Facebook, Threads, Bluesky, Reddit, X, YouTube, and LinkedIn.

first_comment_media[].description: Image files to attach to the first comment as inline images. Currently supported on Reddit. Not available for scheduled or queued posts. Files only (multipart parts): a URL sent in this field is ignored.

facebook_title.description: [Facebook] Specific title. Fallbacks to `title`. Ignored if facebook_media_type is STORIES.

tiktok_title.description: [TikTok] Specific title. Fallbacks to `title`, then to `description` (or `caption`) when there is no title at all.

threads_topic_tag.description: [Threads] A topic tag for the post (1-50 characters). Cannot contain periods (.) or ampersands (&). One tag per post.

bluesky_tags.description: [Bluesky] Up to 8 extra hashtags stored on the post without appearing in the text (comma list or JSON array; leading # optional; 64 characters each). More than 8, like any invalid new Bluesky field, fails only the Bluesky result (results.bluesky.success=false, error_code bluesky_invalid_parameter; HTTP 200).

bluesky_created_at.description: [Bluesky] Date the post is shown and sorted by (ISO 8601 with timezone, not in the future; 2 minutes of clock skew allowed). Default: now.

bluesky_thread_overflow.description: [Bluesky] Text longer than one post (300 characters): publish the rest as replies under the media post (adds thread_count). Without it the text is cut and a warning is returned.

bluesky_captions.description: [Bluesky] JSON array of up to 20 subtitle tracks, one per language: [{"lang":"es","url":"https://.../es.vtt"}] or [{"lang":"en","vtt":"WEBVTT..."}]. WebVTT, at most 20,000 bytes each.

bluesky_video_presentation.description: [Bluesky] How the video is presented: default, or gif (looping, muted, no controls).

cover_timestamp.description: [TikTok] Timestamp in milliseconds for video cover.

brand_content_toggle.description: [TikTok] Set to true for paid partnerships promoting third-party brands.

brand_organic_toggle.description: [TikTok] Set to true when promoting the creator's own business.

share_to_feed.description: [Instagram] Whether to share to feed (only for regular Reels, not Trial Reels).

collaborators.description: [Instagram] Comma-separated list of collaborator usernames. Not available for Trial Reels.

cover_url.description: [Instagram] URL for custom video cover. Alternative to cover_image binary upload.

cover_image.description: [Instagram] Binary cover image for Reels (JPEG, max 8MB). If both cover_image and cover_url are provided, cover_url takes precedence.

audio_name.description: [Instagram] Name of the audio track embedded in your video (Reels only).

instagram_audio_id.description: [Instagram] Licensed music or original sound to attach to the Reel: an `audio_id` from GET /api/uploadposts/instagram/audio. Reels only (400 `instagram_audio_reels_only` otherwise). Needs an Instagram connection made through Meta's newer login; an older one fails with `instagram_reconnect_required` and `connect_url`. Not generally available yet: ignored until Instagram's Unified Login is enabled.

instagram_audio_volume.description: [Instagram] Volume of `instagram_audio_id`, 1-100 (Instagram's default: 100). Not generally available yet: ignored until Instagram's Unified Login is enabled.

instagram_video_volume.description: [Instagram] Volume of the video's own sound when `instagram_audio_id` is set, 1-100 (Instagram's default: 100). Not generally available yet: ignored until Instagram's Unified Login is enabled.

user_tags.description: [Instagram] Comma-separated usernames to tag. Reels; also video Stories (mentions) once that is turned on: not generally available yet on Stories, ignored there until then.

location_id.description: [Instagram] Instagram location ID.

is_ai_generated.description: Cross-platform AI-disclosure flag. Set to `true` to self-disclose the content as AI-generated. On Instagram (Reels, photos, carousels) it is forwarded as Meta's `is_ai_generated` and shows the "AI info" label under the account name; the label cannot be added or removed after publishing. On TikTok it maps to `is_aigc`, on YouTube to `containsSyntheticMedia` and on X to `made_with_ai`; a platform-specific value takes precedence over this alias. See the AI Content Labeling guide.

linkedin_description.description: [LinkedIn] Sent as the LinkedIn commentary. If omitted, reuses `title`.

target_linkedin_page_id.description: [LinkedIn] LinkedIn page ID to upload to an organization page. Send `personal` (or `me`, `member`, `person`) to post to the member's own profile, even when a Page is pinned to the profile.

tags.description: [YouTube] Array of video tags.

thumbnail.description: [YouTube] Custom thumbnail image file (JPG/PNG/GIF/BMP, max 50MB). On Shorts it is set once YouTube finishes processing.

thumbnail_url.description: [YouTube] Alternative: provide thumbnail as a public URL.

containsSyntheticMedia.description: [YouTube] Declaration that video contains AI-generated content.

defaultLanguage.description: [YouTube] Language of title and description (BCP-47 code, e.g., 'es', 'en').

defaultAudioLanguage.description: [YouTube] Language of the video audio (BCP-47 code, e.g., 'es-ES', 'en-US').

allowedCountries.description: [YouTube] Comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes where the video is allowed. Cannot be used with `blockedCountries`. YouTube ignores it on API uploads (not saved); use YouTube Studio.

blockedCountries.description: [YouTube] Comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes where the video is blocked. Cannot be used with `allowedCountries`. YouTube ignores it on API uploads (not saved); use YouTube Studio.

hasPaidProductPlacement.description: [YouTube] Paid product placement / sponsorship declaration (paidProductPlacementDetails). Also set by paid_partnership. If YouTube answers it as false the YouTube result carries a warning.

youtube_localizations.description: [YouTube] JSON object with the translated title and description per BCP-47 language, e.g. {"es": {"title": "...", "description": "..."}}. Requires `defaultLanguage`. Ignored with a warning if YouTube management features are temporarily off.

youtube_brand_partner.description: [YouTube] Brand partner for creator-initiated brand partner access: channel ID (UC..., 24 characters). Handles are not accepted. Ignored with a warning if YouTube management features are temporarily off.

facebook_page_id.description: [Facebook] Facebook Page ID where the video will be posted. Required for Facebook. Auto-detected if only one page is connected.

facebook_description.description: [Facebook] Sent as video description. Ignored for STORIES.

x_long_text_as_post.description: [X] When true, publishes long text as a single post instead of a thread.

nullcast.description: [X] Whether to publish without broadcasting (promoted-only posts).

community_id.description: [X] Community ID for posting to specific communities.

direct_message_deep_link.description: [X] Link to take conversation to private Direct Message.

tagged_user_ids.description: [X] Array of user IDs to tag in the media (max 10).

reply_to_id.description: [X] ID of the tweet to reply to.

exclude_reply_user_ids.description: [X] User IDs to exclude from replying. Requires `reply_to_id`.

pinterest_board_id.description: [Pinterest] Pinterest board ID to publish to. Required when platform includes pinterest.

pinterest_link.description: [Pinterest] Destination link for the video Pin.

pinterest_cover_image_url.description: [Pinterest] URL of an image to use as the video cover.

pinterest_cover_image_content_type.description: [Pinterest] Content type of the cover image (e.g., image/jpeg).

pinterest_cover_image_key_frame_time.description: [Pinterest] Time in milliseconds of the video frame to use as cover.

subreddit.description: [Reddit] Name of the subreddit (without 'r/'). Required when platform includes reddit.

flair_id.description: [Reddit] ID of the flair to apply to the post.

telegram_message_thread_id.description: Telegram: forum topic to post in.

telegram_direct_messages_topic_id.description: Telegram: topic of a channel direct messages chat.

telegram_reply_markup.description: Telegram: InlineKeyboardMarkup JSON with URL buttons.

telegram_reply_to_message_id.description: Telegram: publish as a reply to this message.

telegram_reply_quote.description: Telegram: exact part of the replied message to quote (max 1024).

telegram_reply_parameters.description: Telegram: full ReplyParameters JSON (instead of reply_to_message_id/reply_quote).

telegram_pin.description: Telegram: pin the post after publishing.

telegram_first_comment_as_reply.description: Telegram: first comment as a reply to the post (default true).

telegram_suggested_post_parameters.description: Telegram: SuggestedPostParameters JSON (channel direct messages chats only; a price is not available for now).

telegram_allow_paid_broadcast.description: Telegram: it can spend your bot's Stars. Paid broadcasts charge 0.1 Telegram Stars per message above the free 30 messages/s, from the bot's balance.

telegram_pin_notify.description: Telegram: with telegram_pin, notify group members about the pin (pinning is silent by default; Telegram never notifies a pin in channels or private chats).

telegram_caption_entities.description: Telegram: MessageEntity JSON array for the caption, instead of telegram_parse_mode.

telegram_has_spoiler.description: Telegram: cover the media with a spoiler.

telegram_show_caption_above_media.description: Telegram: show the caption above the media.

telegram_caption_overflow.description: Telegram: caption over 1024 characters: truncate (default, the request is refused with 400) or split (the rest goes as a reply).

telegram_send_by_url.description: Telegram: let Telegram download the URL itself (5 MB photos, 20 MB other files).

telegram_paid_star_count.description: Telegram: paid media price in Telegram Stars (1-25000), paid by the reader.

telegram_paid_payload.description: Telegram: internal reference of the paid media (max 128 bytes).

telegram_send_as.description: Telegram: send the video as animation, video_note, live_photo or document.

telegram_cover.description: Telegram: video cover (public URL or file_id).

telegram_thumbnail.description: Telegram: thumbnail URL (JPEG, under 200 kB, max 320x320).

telegram_media_urls.description: Telegram: comma-separated photo/video URLs (max 9) sent with the video as one album.

telegram_live_photo_photo.description: Telegram: still photo URL of a live photo.

telegram_send_title.description: Telegram: send the text before a video note (default true).

x_video_title.description: X: title shown on the video card. Not generally available yet: ignored until it is turned on.

x_video_description.description: X: description shown on the video card. Not generally available yet: ignored until it is turned on.

x_video_cta.description: X: call to action on the video. Not generally available yet: ignored until it is turned on.

x_video_cta_url.description: X: https URL of visit_site / watch_now. Not generally available yet: ignored until it is turned on.

x_video_cta_app_store_id.description: X app_install: Apple App Store iPhone app id. Not generally available yet: ignored until it is turned on.

x_video_cta_ipad_app_store_id.description: X app_install: Apple App Store iPad app id. Not generally available yet: ignored until it is turned on.

x_video_cta_play_store_id.description: X app_install: Google Play app id. Not generally available yet: ignored until it is turned on.

instagram_paid_partnership.description: [Instagram] true: 'Paid partnership' label. Not generally available yet. Only Instagram connections made through Meta's newer login; an older one fails with `instagram_reconnect_required` and `connect_url`.

instagram_sponsor_ids.description: [Instagram] (JSON sent as text in this form field) Up to 2 Instagram user ids of the brands (JSON list or comma-separated); turns the Paid partnership label on. Not generally available yet. Only Instagram connections made through Meta's newer login; an older one fails with `instagram_reconnect_required` and `connect_url`.

instagram_poll.description: [Instagram] (JSON sent as text in this form field) Poll in the caption: JSON list of 2-4 options (1-25 characters) or {option_a..option_d}. The caption is the question. Feed, carousels and Reels; not Stories. Not generally available yet. Only Instagram connections made through Meta's newer login; an older one fails with `instagram_reconnect_required` and `connect_url`.

instagram_poll_extended.description: [Instagram] true: the poll stays open (default 3 days). Only with instagram_poll. Not generally available yet. Only Instagram connections made through Meta's newer login; an older one fails with `instagram_reconnect_required` and `connect_url`.

instagram_comment_prompt.description: [Instagram] true: the caption becomes a prompt answered in the comments. Not with instagram_poll. Not generally available yet. Only Instagram connections made through Meta's newer login; an older one fails with `instagram_reconnect_required` and `connect_url`.

instagram_product_tags.description: [Instagram] (JSON sent as text in this form field) JSON list of {product_id, x, y} (x/y only on images, 0-1); on a carousel, one list per item. Up to 20 (Reels 30, 5 per carousel item). Needs an approved Instagram Shop. Not generally available yet. Only Instagram connections made through Meta's newer login; an older one fails with `instagram_reconnect_required` and `connect_url`.

threads_text_spoilers.description: [Threads] Hide parts of the text of the first post as spoilers: JSON array like [{"offset": 0, "length": 5}] (characters of that post, up to 10 spoilers). An invalid value is refused with 400 `threads_invalid_field` before anything is queued. Not generally available yet: ignored until it is turned on.

threads_enable_reply_approvals.description: [Threads] true = replies to the post wait for your approval (GET /api/uploadposts/threads/pending-replies lists them). Not generally available yet: ignored until it is turned on.

threads_allowlisted_country_codes.description: [Threads] Show the post only in these countries: comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes (e.g. US,CA); applies to every post of the thread. An invalid value is refused with 400 `threads_invalid_field` before anything is queued. Only accounts Meta made eligible (GET /api/uploadposts/threads/geo-gating); on any other account the post fails with `threads_geo_gating_not_eligible`. Not generally available yet: ignored until it is turned on.

threads_location_id.description: [Threads] Tag a place: a numeric Threads location id from GET /api/uploadposts/threads/locations. Needs the location permission on the Threads connection (if it is missing the post fails with `account_permission_denied`: reconnect Threads). An invalid value is refused with 400 `threads_invalid_field` before anything is queued. Not generally available yet: ignored until it is turned on.

threads_share_to_instagram.description: [Threads] true = also share the post to the account's Instagram Story; the result carries `crossreshare_to_ig_status` (SUCCESS / FAILED). Needs the share permission on the Threads connection (if it is missing the post fails with `account_permission_denied`: reconnect Threads). Not generally available yet: ignored until it is turned on.

threads_share_to_instagram_dark_mode.description: [Threads] Same as threads_share_to_instagram, with the Story in dark mode. Not generally available yet: ignored until it is turned on.

threads_spoiler_media.description: [Threads] true = blur the images or videos of the post as a spoiler. Image, video and carousel posts. An invalid value is refused with 400 `threads_invalid_field` before anything is queued. Not generally available yet: ignored until it is turned on.

200.description: Upload completed synchronously or async processing started.

202.description:
Post scheduled or queued successfully.

Or: Not generally available yet (team roles and post approvals). The caller is an Editor or Contributor team member: the post is NOT published or scheduled; it waits for review (pending_approval) or stays as a draft. Track it with approval_id (`/uploadposts/approvals/{approval_id}`) or with GET /uploadposts/status?request_id=.

403.description: With team roles on: error_code team_role_forbidden, team_profile_forbidden, team_approvals_disabled, team_page_forbidden or team_page_not_pinned (see TeamAccessError).

post.description: Upload photos (and mixed media for Instagram/Threads carousels) to social media platforms. Supports TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, X (Twitter), Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, Reddit, Discord, and Telegram.

paid_partnership.description: [All] Marks the post as sponsored / paid partnership. Mapped to TikTok brand_content_toggle, YouTube hasPaidProductPlacement and X paid_partnership; Facebook and Pinterest also need the sponsor id. Networks without a native label publish without it and get a warning. Network-specific fields win. On TikTok it is not allowed with privacy_level=SELF_ONLY (400 commercial_disclosure_privacy_conflict) and drafts do not carry it. See https://docs.upload-post.com/guides/paid-partnership

x_paid_partnership.description: [X] Paid partnership disclosure on the first post. Wins over paid_partnership.

facebook_sponsor_id.description: [Facebook] Sponsor's Page id for the branded content tag (sponsor_id). Page photos, Page videos (facebook_media_type=VIDEO) and text posts; not Reels or Stories.

pinterest_sponsor_id.description: [Pinterest] Sponsor account id for the paid partnership label (sponsor_id). Pinterest closed beta only.

disclose_commercial.description: [TikTok] Disclose post content switch. With true, send your_brand and/or branded_content.

your_brand.description: [TikTok] With disclose_commercial: promoting your own business.

branded_content.description: [TikTok] With disclose_commercial: paid partnership with a third-party brand. With privacy_level=SELF_ONLY the post is published as PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE.

photos[].description: Array of photo files. Instagram & Threads also accept videos for mixed carousels.

title.description: Default title/caption. Required for Reddit; optional for all other platforms. Platform-specific titles override this.

description.description: Optional extended text used on LinkedIn commentary, Facebook descriptions, Pinterest notes, and Reddit bodies. Ignored elsewhere, including TikTok when there is a `tiktok_title` or `title`: a TikTok photo description must then be sent as `tiktok_description` (the TikTok caption comes from `tiktok_title`, falling back to `title`). With no title at all it becomes the TikTok description.

scheduled_date.description: ISO-8601 date/time to schedule publishing. Must be in the future (≤365 days). Cannot be used with `add_to_queue`.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier. Defaults to UTC.

async_upload.description: If true, returns immediately with a `request_id`.

add_to_queue.description: If true, schedules to next available queue slot. Cannot be used with `scheduled_date`.

first_comment.description: Automatically post a first comment after publishing.

first_comment_media[].description: One or more image files to attach to the first comment. Currently supported on Reddit. Not available for scheduled or queued posts. Files only (multipart parts): a URL sent in this field is ignored.

threads_topic_tag.description: [Threads] A topic tag for the post (1-50 characters). Cannot contain periods (.) or ampersands (&). One tag per post.

bluesky_tags.description: [Bluesky] Up to 8 extra hashtags stored on the post without appearing in the text (comma list or JSON array; leading # optional; 64 characters each). More than 8, like any invalid new Bluesky field, fails only the Bluesky result (results.bluesky.success=false, error_code bluesky_invalid_parameter; HTTP 200).

bluesky_created_at.description: [Bluesky] Date the post is shown and sorted by (ISO 8601 with timezone, not in the future; 2 minutes of clock skew allowed). Default: now.

bluesky_thread_overflow.description: [Bluesky] Text longer than one post (300 characters): publish the rest as replies under the media post (adds thread_count). Without it the text is cut and a warning is returned.

bluesky_gif_as_video.description: [Bluesky] Publish a single animated GIF as a looping video (presentation gif). Counts against the account's daily Bluesky video quota and needs a verified email in Bluesky.

target_linkedin_page_id.description: [LinkedIn] LinkedIn page ID to upload to an organization. Send `personal` (or `me`, `member`, `person`) to post to the member's own profile, even when a Page is pinned to the profile.

facebook_page_id.description: [Facebook] Facebook Page ID. Required when platform includes facebook. Auto-detected if only one page is connected.

x_long_text_as_post.description: [X] When true, publishes long text as a single post.

tagged_user_ids.description: [X] User IDs to tag in photos (max 10).

reply_to_id.description: [X] ID of the tweet to reply to.

exclude_reply_user_ids.description: [X] User IDs to exclude from replying.

auto_add_music.description: [TikTok] Automatically add background music to photos.

photo_cover_index.description: [TikTok] Index (0-based) of the photo to use as cover/thumbnail.

tiktok_description.description: [TikTok] Description for photo posts. The generic `description` / `caption` fields reach TikTok only when there is no `tiktok_title` or `title`.

location_id.description: [Instagram] Instagram location ID.

is_ai_generated.description: Cross-platform AI-disclosure flag. Set to `true` to self-disclose the content as AI-generated. On Instagram (single photos and carousels) it is forwarded as Meta's `is_ai_generated` and shows the "AI info" label under the account name; for carousels it applies to the whole post. The label cannot be added or removed after publishing. On X it maps to `made_with_ai`. See the AI Content Labeling guide.

pinterest_board_id.description: [Pinterest] Board ID. Required when platform includes pinterest.

subreddit.description: [Reddit] Subreddit name (without 'r/'). Required when platform includes reddit.

telegram_message_thread_id.description: Telegram: forum topic to post in.

telegram_direct_messages_topic_id.description: Telegram: topic of a channel direct messages chat.

telegram_reply_markup.description: Telegram: InlineKeyboardMarkup JSON with URL buttons.

telegram_reply_to_message_id.description: Telegram: publish as a reply to this message.

telegram_reply_quote.description: Telegram: exact part of the replied message to quote (max 1024).

telegram_reply_parameters.description: Telegram: full ReplyParameters JSON (instead of reply_to_message_id/reply_quote).

telegram_pin.description: Telegram: pin the post after publishing.

telegram_first_comment_as_reply.description: Telegram: first comment as a reply to the post (default true).

telegram_suggested_post_parameters.description: Telegram: SuggestedPostParameters JSON (channel direct messages chats only; a price is not available for now).

telegram_allow_paid_broadcast.description: Telegram: it can spend your bot's Stars. Paid broadcasts charge 0.1 Telegram Stars per message above the free 30 messages/s, from the bot's balance.

telegram_pin_notify.description: Telegram: with telegram_pin, notify group members about the pin (pinning is silent by default; Telegram never notifies a pin in channels or private chats).

telegram_caption_entities.description: Telegram: MessageEntity JSON array for the caption, instead of telegram_parse_mode.

telegram_has_spoiler.description: Telegram: cover the media with a spoiler.

telegram_show_caption_above_media.description: Telegram: show the caption above the media.

telegram_caption_overflow.description: Telegram: caption over 1024 characters: truncate (default, the request is refused with 400) or split (the rest goes as a reply).

telegram_send_by_url.description: Telegram: let Telegram download the URL itself (5 MB photos, 20 MB other files).

telegram_paid_star_count.description: Telegram: paid media price in Telegram Stars (1-25000), paid by the reader.

telegram_paid_payload.description: Telegram: internal reference of the paid media (max 128 bytes).

instagram_paid_partnership.description: [Instagram] true: 'Paid partnership' label. Not generally available yet. Only Instagram connections made through Meta's newer login; an older one fails with `instagram_reconnect_required` and `connect_url`.

instagram_sponsor_ids.description: [Instagram] (JSON sent as text in this form field) Up to 2 Instagram user ids of the brands (JSON list or comma-separated); turns the Paid partnership label on. Not generally available yet. Only Instagram connections made through Meta's newer login; an older one fails with `instagram_reconnect_required` and `connect_url`.

instagram_poll.description: [Instagram] (JSON sent as text in this form field) Poll in the caption: JSON list of 2-4 options (1-25 characters) or {option_a..option_d}. The caption is the question. Feed, carousels and Reels; not Stories. Not generally available yet. Only Instagram connections made through Meta's newer login; an older one fails with `instagram_reconnect_required` and `connect_url`.

instagram_poll_extended.description: [Instagram] true: the poll stays open (default 3 days). Only with instagram_poll. Not generally available yet. Only Instagram connections made through Meta's newer login; an older one fails with `instagram_reconnect_required` and `connect_url`.

instagram_comment_prompt.description: [Instagram] true: the caption becomes a prompt answered in the comments. Not with instagram_poll. Not generally available yet. Only Instagram connections made through Meta's newer login; an older one fails with `instagram_reconnect_required` and `connect_url`.

instagram_product_tags.description: [Instagram] (JSON sent as text in this form field) JSON list of {product_id, x, y} (x/y only on images, 0-1); on a carousel, one list per item. Up to 20 (Reels 30, 5 per carousel item). Needs an approved Instagram Shop. Not generally available yet. Only Instagram connections made through Meta's newer login; an older one fails with `instagram_reconnect_required` and `connect_url`.

threads_text_spoilers.description: [Threads] Hide parts of the text of the first post as spoilers: JSON array like [{"offset": 0, "length": 5}] (characters of that post, up to 10 spoilers). An invalid value is refused with 400 `threads_invalid_field` before anything is queued. Not generally available yet: ignored until it is turned on.

threads_enable_reply_approvals.description: [Threads] true = replies to the post wait for your approval (GET /api/uploadposts/threads/pending-replies lists them). Not generally available yet: ignored until it is turned on.

threads_allowlisted_country_codes.description: [Threads] Show the post only in these countries: comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes (e.g. US,CA); applies to every post of the thread. An invalid value is refused with 400 `threads_invalid_field` before anything is queued. Only accounts Meta made eligible (GET /api/uploadposts/threads/geo-gating); on any other account the post fails with `threads_geo_gating_not_eligible`. Not generally available yet: ignored until it is turned on.

threads_location_id.description: [Threads] Tag a place: a numeric Threads location id from GET /api/uploadposts/threads/locations. Needs the location permission on the Threads connection (if it is missing the post fails with `account_permission_denied`: reconnect Threads). An invalid value is refused with 400 `threads_invalid_field` before anything is queued. Not generally available yet: ignored until it is turned on.

threads_share_to_instagram.description: [Threads] true = also share the post to the account's Instagram Story; the result carries `crossreshare_to_ig_status` (SUCCESS / FAILED). Needs the share permission on the Threads connection (if it is missing the post fails with `account_permission_denied`: reconnect Threads). Not generally available yet: ignored until it is turned on.

threads_share_to_instagram_dark_mode.description: [Threads] Same as threads_share_to_instagram, with the Story in dark mode. Not generally available yet: ignored until it is turned on.

threads_spoiler_media.description: [Threads] true = blur the images or videos of the post as a spoiler. Image, video and carousel posts. An invalid value is refused with 400 `threads_invalid_field` before anything is queued. Not generally available yet: ignored until it is turned on.

200.description: Upload completed synchronously or async processing started.

202.description:
Post scheduled or queued successfully.

Or: Not generally available yet (team roles and post approvals). The caller is an Editor or Contributor team member: the post is NOT published or scheduled; it waits for review (pending_approval) or stays as a draft. Track it with approval_id (`/uploadposts/approvals/{approval_id}`) or with GET /uploadposts/status?request_id=.

403.description: With team roles on: error_code team_role_forbidden, team_profile_forbidden, team_approvals_disabled, team_page_forbidden or team_page_not_pinned (see TeamAccessError).

post.description: Upload text-only posts to social media platforms. Supports X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Facebook, Threads, Reddit, Bluesky, Discord, and Telegram. Automatically creates threads on X (>280 chars), Threads (>500 chars), and Bluesky (>300 chars).

paid_partnership.description: [All] Marks the post as sponsored / paid partnership. Mapped to TikTok brand_content_toggle, YouTube hasPaidProductPlacement and X paid_partnership; Facebook and Pinterest also need the sponsor id. Networks without a native label publish without it and get a warning. Network-specific fields win. On TikTok it is not allowed with privacy_level=SELF_ONLY (400 commercial_disclosure_privacy_conflict) and drafts do not carry it. See https://docs.upload-post.com/guides/paid-partnership

x_paid_partnership.description: [X] Paid partnership disclosure on the first post. Wins over paid_partnership.

facebook_sponsor_id.description: [Facebook] Sponsor's Page id for the branded content tag (sponsor_id). Page photos, Page videos (facebook_media_type=VIDEO) and text posts; not Reels or Stories.

title.description: Default text content for the post.

description.description: Optional extended body used on Reddit (becomes post text). Ignored elsewhere.

x_long_text_as_post.description: [X] When true, long text is published as a single post.

quote_tweet_id.description: [X] ID of the tweet to quote. Mutually exclusive with `card_uri`, `poll_options`, and `direct_message_deep_link`.

direct_message_deep_link.description: [X] Direct Message deep link. Mutually exclusive with `card_uri`, `quote_tweet_id`, and `poll_options`.

card_uri.description: [X] Card URI for Twitter Cards/ads. Mutually exclusive with `quote_tweet_id`, `direct_message_deep_link`, and `poll_options`.

poll_options.description: [X] Array of poll options (2-4 options, max 25 chars each). Mutually exclusive with `card_uri`, `quote_tweet_id`, and `direct_message_deep_link`.

poll_reply_settings.description: [X] Who can reply to poll. Requires `poll_options`.

reply_to_id.description: [X/Bluesky] ID or URL of the post to reply to.

exclude_reply_user_ids.description: [X] User IDs to exclude from replying. Requires `reply_to_id`.

facebook_page_id.description: [Facebook] Facebook Page ID. Required when platform includes facebook. Auto-detected if only one page is connected.

facebook_link_url.description: [Facebook] Optional URL for link preview in text posts. Overrides generic `link_url` for Facebook.

link_url.description: Generic URL to include as a link preview card. Works for LinkedIn, Bluesky, Facebook, and Reddit. Platform-specific parameters (`linkedin_link_url`, `bluesky_link_url`, `facebook_link_url`, `reddit_link_url`) take priority.

linkedin_link_url.description: [LinkedIn] Optional URL for link preview card in text posts. Overrides generic `link_url` for LinkedIn.

bluesky_link_url.description: [Bluesky] Optional URL for external embed link preview in text posts. Overrides generic `link_url` for Bluesky.

reddit_link_url.description: [Reddit] URL for creating a Reddit link post with a URL preview card. Overrides generic `link_url` for Reddit.

threads_long_text_as_post.description: [Threads] If true, long text is a single post. If false, creates a thread if >500 chars.

subreddit.description: [Reddit] Subreddit name (without 'r/'). Required when platform includes reddit.

threads_share_to_instagram_dark_mode.description: [Threads] Same as threads_share_to_instagram, with the Story in dark mode. Not generally available yet: ignored until it is turned on.

threads_gif_id.description: [Threads] Attach a GIF: the id of a GIPHY GIF. Text posts only. An invalid value is refused with 400 `threads_invalid_field` before anything is queued. Not generally available yet: ignored until it is turned on.

threads_ghost_post.description: [Threads] true = ghost post (a temporary post; GET /api/uploadposts/threads/ghost-posts shows when it expires). One text post of up to 500 characters; only text spoilers can go with it (no topic tag, reply, quote, link, poll, GIF, reply control, AI label, reply approvals, countries, location or Instagram share). An invalid value is refused with 400 `threads_invalid_field` before anything is queued. Not generally available yet: ignored until it is turned on.

facebook_tags.description: [Facebook] Facebook user ids to tag in the Page post, comma-separated (numeric). Facebook only accepts tags together with facebook_place_id. Not generally available yet: ignored until it is turned on.

facebook_backdated_time.description: [Facebook] Backdate the Page post: a past Unix timestamp or ISO 8601 date. Not generally available yet: ignored until it is turned on.

facebook_backdated_time_granularity.description: [Facebook] How precisely facebook_backdated_time is shown. Not generally available yet: ignored until it is turned on.

facebook_place_id.description: [Facebook] Page id of the place to tag on the post (required by facebook_tags).

description.description: Post commentary/text that appears above the document.

get.description: Check the status of asynchronous uploads (via `request_id`) or scheduled posts (via `job_id`). At least one parameter must be provided.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: The request identifier returned by upload endpoints when `async_upload=true`.

parameters.name: job_id
parameters.description: The job identifier returned by scheduled posts (with `scheduled_date`).

400.description: Missing both request_id and job_id.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of past uploads across all platforms, ordered most recent first.
Retrieve all pending scheduled posts for the authenticated user.
The options a scheduled post was scheduled with (limited to what PATCH can change), signed media URLs and whether it can still be edited.

patch.description: Update a pending scheduled post: date, text and any other upload option. The stored media is reused (it cannot be replaced), and so are the profile and platforms. Edits are refused with 409 once the scheduler has picked the post up or within 60 seconds of its publish time.

scheduled_date.description: New ISO-8601 date/time in UTC. Must be in the future and within 1 year.

title.description: New post title/caption, applied to every platform of the post.

caption.description: New caption/description, applied to every platform of the post.

timezone.description: IANA timezone; when set, scheduled_date is read in it.

platform_content.description: Per-platform text keyed by platform, e.g. {"youtube": {"title": "..."}}. Only the platforms listed change.

fields.description: Other upload options by their form field names (as the upload endpoints take them): per-platform titles/descriptions/first comments on video and photo posts, TikTok privacy_level/cover_timestamp/is_aigc/..., Instagram thumb_offset/share_to_feed/is_ai_generated/..., YouTube privacyStatus/tags/categoryId/..., and the options of the other platforms. null removes an option. Unknown or internal keys are ignored. The Threads (threads_gif_id, threads_text_spoilers, threads_ghost_post...), X video card and clip (x_video_*, x_clip_*) and Facebook text-post (facebook_tags, facebook_backdated_time*) options that are not generally available yet are ignored here too until they are turned on; an invalid value then answers 400 (`threads_invalid_field` or `invalid_parameter`).

cover_image_base64.description: New Reels cover image (Instagram/Facebook), base64 or data URL.

409.description: The post is being published, has already run, or is due within 60 seconds. Nothing was changed.

error.example: This post is being published right now, so it can no longer be edited.

delete.description: Cancel and delete a scheduled post and its associated assets.

message.example: Job abc123 cancelled and assets deleted.

get.description: Signed URL of a small JPEG of the post's video or first image. A post without one gets it built once and kept. Call it only for posts you display; the list already carries most thumbnails.

200.description: thumbnail_url, or null when the post has no image.

202.description: Another request is building it. Retry after retry_after seconds.

429.description: Too many thumbnails being built at once. Retry after retry_after seconds.

get.description: Retrieve the current queue configuration (timezone, time slots, active days) for a profile.

post.description: Update the queue configuration (timezone, time slots, active days) for a profile.

profile_username.description: The profile to update settings for.

slots.description: Array of slot objects (max 24), or the string "auto" to let the queue use the best times.

slots_mode.description: Same as slots="auto" / back to the fixed slots.

auto_slots_count.description: Auto mode: hours per day. Default: number of fixed slots, or 3.

auto_platforms.description: Auto mode: networks to use. Default: every connected network with best times except X, which is only used when listed.

refresh.description: Auto mode: recompute the best times if their cached answer is at least 24 h old (YouTube and X: 7 days).

get.description: Preview the next upcoming queue slots and their availability for a profile.
Get the next available queue slot for a profile.

Retrieve analytics data for a user profile across one or more social media platforms. Returns metrics like followers, views, impressions, reach, and time series data. Note: Instagram's API renamed 'impressions' to 'views'; both fields are returned for compatibility.

parameters.name: profile_username
parameters.description: The unique username of the profile.

parameters.name: platforms
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of platforms: instagram, tiktok, linkedin, facebook, x, youtube, threads, pinterest, reddit, bluesky.

parameters.name: page_id

get.description: Who follows a connected account, when they are online, what they tap on the profile and how it compares to its category. One endpoint per QUESTION with a `platform`, exactly like /uploadposts/comments and /uploadposts/post-analytics — never one URL per network. Only `tiktok` answers today; any other value returns 400 with error_code `platform_not_supported` and a message naming the supported ones. `activity_by_hour` (24 entries, followers online per hour, summed over the window) is the field to build a publishing schedule on. The window is trimmed to what the platform accepts — at most 60 days, always ending before today — so read the `range` that comes back, not the one you sent. Requires the `profile_analytics` capability.

get.description: The best hours to publish for a connected account on one network, in the requested timezone. One endpoint per QUESTION with a `platform`. Every answer carries `source` (audience_activity: the network reports followers online per hour, TikTok Business and Instagram 100+ followers; account_posts: the account's recent posts vs its median post, needs 10+ posts; upload_post_history: posts published through Upload-Post whose analytics were read, the only source for X and personal LinkedIn profiles; none: no data yet, best_times empty) and `confidence` (high/medium/low/null). YouTube uses the Data API, not Analytics (no hour dimension). Facebook's page_fans_online was deprecated by Meta, so Facebook is post-based. On networks whose quota is shared with publishing (YouTube, Reddit, LinkedIn, Pinterest) best times have their own daily budget; when it or the network quota runs out, the answer uses only data already stored and says so in `warnings`. Cached 24 h (7 days for YouTube and X), in UTC, so another `timezone` costs no call.

get.description: What to tag a post with (`type=hashtags`) and what people search around a keyword (`type=keywords`). One endpoint per QUESTION with a `platform`, never one URL per network. Only `tiktok` answers today; any other value returns 400 with error_code `platform_not_supported`. `type=hashtags` needs the `profile_analytics` capability, which any recent connection has; `type=keywords` needs `trend_search`, which is granted only when the account is (re)connected. `type=trending` (no `q`) returns the 20 searches trending on TikTok right now and needs `trend_search` too; it is not generally available yet: while it is off, `trending` is answered as an unknown type (400 `invalid_parameter`). With it on, `personalized=true` asks TikTok for searches personalized for the account (`trending` and `keywords`). `pinterest` (not generally available yet: until then `platform_not_supported`): `type=keywords` returns Pinterest Trends' top trending keywords that contain `q`, for `region` (default `US`; Pinterest's region codes such as `GB+IE`) and `trend_type` (`growing`, `monthly`, `yearly`, `seasonal`; default `growing`), cached 1 h. The full Trends API (interests, ages, genders, topics, product categories) is in `GET /uploadposts/pinterest/api/trends/...`.

language.description: Forces the connection page language for this profile. When omitted, the page auto-detects the visitor's browser language and falls back to English.

ui_labels.description: Flat object of connect-page i18n dot-path keys mapped to replacement strings, for white-label text overrides beyond connect_title/connect_description/redirect_button_text. Max 100 entries; keys must match ^[a-zA-Z0-9_.]+$; values must be strings of at most 300 characters. Omitting the field leaves previously stored labels untouched; sending null or {} clears them. Returned inside the profile object by GET /uploadposts/users/validate-jwt. Keys refer to the connect page's own translation keys, so only override keys you have confirmed exist.

client_approval.description: Not generally available yet (post approvals). true lets the end client approve or reject the pending posts of this profile from the connect page (`/uploadposts/approvals/client`). Stored on the profile; generate again with false to turn it off.

connect_theme.description: Forces the connection page theme; `auto` (or null) follows the visitor's preference.

preserve_settings.description: Mint a link without changing the profile's saved connect-page settings. Without it, every setting this request does not send (redirect_url, logo_image, redirect_button_text, connect_title, connect_description, platforms, language) is cleared. With `true`, nothing is written to the profile and `platforms` applies to this link only: the link shows those networks, whatever list the profile has saved. Cannot be sent together with a setting that is stored (400 `preserve_settings_conflict`).

access_url.description: Secure URL for the user to visit and link accounts.

settings_preserved.description: Present and `true` when the link was minted with `preserve_settings`: the profile was not changed.

400.description:
Missing username, or an invalid connect_theme, ui_labels, client_approval (true or false; checked while post approvals are on) or preserve_settings.
error_code `invalid_client_approval` for client_approval; `invalid_preserve_settings` when preserve_settings is not a boolean; `preserve_settings_conflict` when it is sent together with a stored setting; `invalid_platforms` when, with preserve_settings, platforms is not a list of names.

post.description: Submit a media processing job using an FFmpeg command template. Supports single or multiple input files via multipart upload or JSON with URLs. Jobs are asynchronous — poll the status endpoint until finished.

file.description: Primary media file to process. Referenced as {input} or {input0}.

full_command.description: FFmpeg command template using {input}/{input0}, {input1}, etc. and {output} placeholders. Example: 'ffmpeg -y -i {input} -c:v libx264 -crf 23 {output}'. Every -i must be an uploaded input ({input}/{inputN}) or a '-f lavfi' source; {output} is the only output. No protocols or URLs, no movie=/amovie=/sendcmd/zmq, no absolute paths except fonts under /usr/share/fonts/, no '..', no -safe 0. -stream_loop -1, -loop 1 or a lavfi source without a duration need -t, -shortest or -frames; -stream_loop goes from -1 to 100. The job is charged max(input duration, output duration).

files.description: Array of input file URLs. Referenced as {input0}, {input1}, etc.

full_command.description: FFmpeg command template using {input0}, {input1}, etc. and {output} placeholders.

job_id.description: Unique job identifier for polling status.

get.description: Poll the status of an FFmpeg processing job. Statuses: PENDING, PROCESSING, FINISHED, ERROR.
Download the processed file when job status is FINISHED. Returns binary media with appropriate Content-Type and Content-Disposition headers.
Check your current FFmpeg usage, remaining quota, and processing history for the current month.
