webhook_url.description: URL to receive webhook POST requests.

webhook_events.description: Which events the account webhook receives: an object {event: true|false} or a list of names; both are stored as sent and returned the same way. Omitted or empty = every event except the opt-in ones.

slack_webhook_url.description: Slack Incoming Webhook URL for notifications (public URL; an empty value clears it).

whatsapp_to_phone.description: Phone number that receives WhatsApp notifications.

400.description: No valid field, or a webhook_url / slack_webhook_url that is not a public URL.

403.description: Team members cannot change where the owner's notifications are delivered.

post.description: Sent to your webhook URL when an upload completes (success or failure).
Sent when a social account is connected, disconnected, or requires re-authentication.

get.description: Current webhook and Telegram notification settings of the account, including webhook_secret.

delete.description: Clears webhook_url, webhook_events and webhook_secret and switches the webhook channel off. Webhook subscriptions are not touched.

get.description: Retrieve a list of recent media (posts, reels, videos, pins, tweets, etc.) from a connected social media account. Supports Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, X (Twitter), Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, and Reddit.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: The platform to retrieve media from.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Profile username as configured in Upload-Post.

parameters.name: page_urn
parameters.description: LinkedIn only. Selects which LinkedIn page to fetch posts from. Accepts a numeric organization ID (e.g., 12345), a full URN (e.g., urn:li:organization:12345), or 'me' to force the connected member's personal profile. If omitted, accounts connected as an organization admin auto-resolve to their first administered organization; otherwise the personal profile is used.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of media items to return. Defaults to 25 and is clamped to 1-100, then capped again by the platform's own maximum page size: Instagram/Facebook/Threads/Bluesky/X/Pinterest/Reddit/LinkedIn 100, YouTube 50, TikTok 20.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque next-page token. Pass back exactly the value returned in pagination.next_cursor by the previous response. Not supported on LinkedIn, Discord and Telegram: sending a cursor for those platforms returns 400 with a message naming the platform.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Bluesky only. Which posts to list (Bluesky's author feed filter).

parameters.name: include_pins
parameters.description: Bluesky only. true puts the pinned post first, with pinned: true.

id.description: Platform-specific unique identifier for the media item.

caption.description: Text content, caption, or title of the post.

media_url.description: Direct URL to the media file (image or video). Available on most platforms. Returns null for TikTok, YouTube, and when the platform does not provide a direct media URL. URLs are temporary and may expire.

permalink.description: Direct URL to the post on the platform.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the post was created.

thumbnail_url.description: URL of the thumbnail or preview image.

post_id.description: Bluesky: the post's at:// URI, always present (id stays the cid).

pinned.description: Bluesky: always present; true for the pinned post (include_pins=true).

pagination.description: Page metadata. Additive: every pre-existing response key is unchanged.

limit.description: The effective limit applied after clamping and per-platform capping.

next_cursor.description: Token to pass as 'cursor' on the next request. Null on the last page.

has_more.description: True when another page is available.

400.description: Missing or invalid parameters, platform account not linked, or a cursor was supplied for LinkedIn, Discord or Telegram (which do not support cursors). Bluesky: error_code `bluesky_invalid_parameter` for a wrong filter or include_pins.

get.description: List comments on one of your posts. Supported platforms: Instagram, Facebook, YouTube (account must be connected with the youtube.force-ssl scope), LinkedIn (organization posts) and TikTok. For YouTube, post_id is the video ID; for LinkedIn, post_id is the post URN (e.g. urn:li:ugcPost:123); for TikTok, post_id is the video id. Instagram comments are returned newest-first per Meta Graph API v3.2+. Pass comment_id to get the replies under one comment instead of the post's top-level comments (TikTok, Threads, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn company Pages). TikTok requires the `comments` capability — TikTok grants comment permission only at the moment the account is connected, so an account connected earlier must be reconnected from Manage Users or the call answers 400 with error_code `tiktok_reconnect_required`. On TikTok, post_url accepts a tiktok.com/@user/video/<id> URL. Successful responses are cached for 60 seconds per account and query string; any comment write made through Upload-Post by the same account clears that cache. On X the mentions page behind the listing is also kept for 120 seconds per X account. Bluesky: without depth, parent_height or comment_id the listing is unchanged (same fields as before). With any of them it returns the thread view in one call (no pagination, limit caps top-level replies): depth nests replies in `replies`, parent_height returns the posts above in `parents`, comment_id (a reply's at:// URI) returns the replies to that reply; post_id/post_url/comment_id then also accept a bsky.app link, each comment adds parent_id, quote_count and hidden (hidden by the author with thread controls) and the response adds hidden_replies. Both need the Bluesky account connected.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Platform to list comments from. Reddit answers 503 reddit_unavailable.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Profile username as configured in Upload-Post.

parameters.name: post_id
parameters.description: Post identifier. YouTube = the video ID; LinkedIn = the post URN (urn:li:ugcPost:...); Instagram = numeric media ID. Use post_id or post_url (one is required).

parameters.name: post_url
parameters.description: Full post URL. Alternative to post_id.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum comments to return per page. LinkedIn's top-level listing ignores it (LinkedIn's first page, no pagination); LinkedIn replies apply it.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Pagination cursor returned in `pagination.next_cursor` of the previous response. Pass it back to fetch the next page. Named `after` on this endpoint (`cursor` is ignored here). On LinkedIn replies it is a number.

parameters.name: comment_id
parameters.description: TikTok, Threads, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and Bluesky (the reply's at:// URI or bsky.app link; turns on the thread view). Returns the replies hanging off this comment instead of the post's top-level comments - the same question narrowed to a parent, not a separate URL, with the same pagination. post_id is still required. On LinkedIn it can be the comment_urn from the listing; a bare id is looked up among the post's first 250 comments (404 `linkedin_comment_not_found` otherwise). LinkedIn replies are readable on company Page posts only: 403 `linkedin_personal_not_supported` for a personal-profile connection, 403 `linkedin_page_access_denied` when LinkedIn refuses a Page connection (admin role lost). A comment_id in the wrong format answers 400 `invalid_comment_id`; one Instagram or Facebook does not know answers 404 `comment_not_found` (a comment without replies is a 200 with an empty list; on LinkedIn an unknown comment_urn is also an empty 200). On Facebook post_id is still required: it picks the Page whose token reads the comment. Other platforms answer 400 `platform_not_supported`. TikTok indexes a newly created comment asynchronously: listing within ~10 seconds of writing one returns a list without it.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Bluesky only, turns on the thread view. Levels of nested replies (each comment's `replies`).

parameters.name: parent_height
parameters.description: Bluesky only, turns on the thread view. Posts above post_id to return in `parents`.

parent_id.description: Bluesky thread view: at:// URI of the reply it answers; null when it answers the post.

hidden.description: Bluesky thread view: hidden by the post's author (thread controls).

replies.description: Bluesky thread view: nested replies, same fields, down to `depth`.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor to pass as `after` for the next page. Null on the last page.

has_next.description: True if more pages are available.

hidden_replies.description: Bluesky thread view: at:// URIs of the replies hidden by the author.

parents.description: Bluesky thread view, with parent_height: the posts above post_id, nearest first.

400.description: Missing parameters, invalid post identifier, limit outside 1-50, or an unsupported platform. error_code `invalid_comment_id` (comment_id in the wrong format), `invalid_post_url` (post_id is not a URL or id of a post), `invalid_cursor` (LinkedIn replies: after is not the number from next_cursor), `platform_not_supported` (comment_id on a platform without replies). TikTok: error_code `tiktok_reconnect_required` (reconnect the account) or `invalid_parameter` (TikTok error 40002: the request itself is wrong, e.g. a post_id that is not one of the account's videos; do not retry it).

403.description: The connected account lacks the required scope (e.g. YouTube not connected with youtube.force-ssl). LinkedIn replies (comment_id): error_code `linkedin_personal_not_supported` (personal-profile connection) or `linkedin_page_access_denied` (Page connection LinkedIn refused); the top-level LinkedIn listing passes LinkedIn's own 403 through. Bluesky thread view: error_code `bluesky_blocked` (a block between the account and the post's author).

404.description: error_code `comment_not_found` (Instagram/Facebook do not know the comment_id) or `linkedin_comment_not_found` (a bare LinkedIn comment_id not among the post's first 250 comments; pass the comment_urn). Bluesky thread view: error_code `bluesky_not_found` (Bluesky cannot find the post or reply).

post.summary: Create a comment or reply (Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok, X, Threads, Bluesky)
post.description: Post a comment or reply on Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok, X, Threads or Bluesky. Provide exactly one of comment_id (reply to that comment), post_id or post_url (top-level comment). Instagram supports replies only, so comment_id is required. For LinkedIn, post_id is the post URN. LinkedIn also accepts an image with the comment (`image` multipart file or `image_url`, JPG/PNG/GIF up to 10 MB): not generally available yet, until then the image is ignored and the comment goes out as text. On TikTok, post_id (the video id) is always required — adding comment_id on top of it turns the call into a reply — and the connection must report the `comments` capability, i.e. a reconnected account, or the call answers 400 with error_code `tiktok_reconnect_required`. On X, links in message are removed unless the X Links add-on is active (a `warnings` array says so; a message made only of links answers 400 `x_links_not_allowed`), and replies, edits and reposts share a daily cap per X account (20 on the Free plan, 200 on paid plans, per UTC day; 429 `x_daily_write_limit` with a Retry-After header). TikTok image comments (not generally available yet; while off, `image_url` and `image` are ignored and `message` stays required): `image_url` (JSON) or a multipart `image` file, JPG/PNG/WebP up to 5 MB, between 360 x 360 and 1080 x 1920 (or 1920 x 1080) pixels; with an image, `message` is optional. An image TikTok cannot take answers 400 `invalid_image` before anything is posted.

user.description: Profile username as configured in Upload-Post.

message.description: The comment text. On X, links are removed unless the X Links add-on is active.

comment_id.description: Reply to this comment. Required for Instagram. Provide exactly one of comment_id, post_id or post_url.

post_id.description: Top-level comment on this post. LinkedIn = post URN (urn:li:ugcPost:...); YouTube = video ID.

post_url.description: Top-level comment on this post (by URL). Alternative to post_id.

image_url.description: TikTok only, not generally available yet: public URL of an image to post as (or with) the comment.

warnings.description: X: present when links were removed from the reply.

400.description: Missing fields, more than one target provided, Instagram without comment_id, or an unsupported platform. X: error_code `x_links_not_allowed` when the reply only contained links. TikTok: error_code `tiktok_reconnect_required` or `invalid_parameter` (TikTok error 40002).

403.description: The connected account lacks the required scope.

429.description: X only: the X account reached its daily cap of replies, edits and reposts (20 on the Free plan, 200 on paid plans, per UTC day). Wait Retry-After seconds.

delete.description: Delete a comment on Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn or TikTok. For LinkedIn, post_id (the post URN) is also required; TikTok deletes from comment_id alone, and only comments written by the connected account. TikTok also requires the `comments` capability (a reconnected account), or the call answers 400 with error_code `tiktok_reconnect_required`. Also accepts POST with the same body.

user.description: Profile username as configured in Upload-Post.

comment_id.description: ID of the comment to delete.

post_id.description: Required for LinkedIn only — the post URN (urn:li:ugcPost:...) the comment belongs to.

400.description: Missing fields, LinkedIn without post_id, or an unsupported platform.

403.description: The connected account lacks the required scope, or you do not own the comment.

post.description: POST alias of DELETE /uploadposts/comments/delete, for clients that cannot send a body with DELETE. Same body and behavior.

user.description: Profile username as configured in Upload-Post.

comment_id.description: ID of the comment to delete.

post_id.description: Required for LinkedIn only — the post URN (urn:li:ugcPost:...) the comment belongs to.

400.description: Missing fields, LinkedIn without post_id, or an unsupported platform.

403.description: The connected account lacks the required scope, or you do not own the comment.

post.summary: Hide, like or pin a comment (multi-platform)
post.description: Moderate a comment on one of your own posts. One endpoint, because every action is a verb that carries its own inverse: hide/unhide, like/unlike, pin/unpin. You send the verb, never a boolean, so replaying a request can never flip a comment back. Platforms: tiktok, facebook, instagram, youtube, threads, bluesky (hide/unhide replies in the account's own threads, like/unlike) and x (like/unlike a reply: `comment_id` is the reply's post id; each call counts toward the daily X write limit shared with replies, edits and reposts, and needs the like permission, so X accounts connected before 2026-11-23 must reconnect; hide/unhide a reply in the account's own conversations is not generally available yet and needs the X permission tweet.moderate.write, `403` `x_reconnect_required` until the account reconnects); linkedin (not generally available yet, until then `400` `platform_not_supported`): like/unlike a comment (optional `reaction_type`), `edit` (`message`), `disable_comments`/`enable_comments` on `post_id` (closing comments DELETES every existing comment on LinkedIn, so it needs `confirm: true`, else `400` `confirmation_required`); any other answers 400 `platform_not_supported`. TikTok requires the `comments` capability (a reconnected account).

platform.description: The network to act on. `linkedin` is not generally available yet and is not in the list until it is (see the description: until then it answers 400 `platform_not_supported`).

user.description: Profile username as configured in Upload-Post.

action.description: The verb to apply. Send the inverse verb to undo it. LinkedIn also takes `edit`, `disable_comments` and `enable_comments`, not generally available yet and not in the list until they are (see the description).

post_id.description: The post the comment hangs from. Required for hide, unhide, pin and unpin; do not send it for like/unlike, which resolve from the comment alone.

reaction_type.description: LinkedIn (not generally available yet): reaction for `like`, one of LIKE, PRAISE, EMPATHY, INTEREST, APPRECIATION, ENTERTAINMENT (default LIKE); another value is 400 `invalid_reaction_type`.

message.description: LinkedIn (not generally available yet): new text of the comment for `edit` (required there).

confirm.description: LinkedIn (not generally available yet): must be true for `disable_comments`, which DELETES every existing comment of the post (otherwise 400 `confirmation_required`).

400.description: error_code `platform_not_supported` (a platform or action this endpoint does not cover, see the description), `tiktok_reconnect_required` (reconnect the account), or `invalid_parameter` (TikTok error 40002: a comment that was deleted, a post_id that is not one of the account's videos, pin on a reply; retrying fails the same way).

403.description: X only: error_code `x_reconnect_required`: X refused the like/unlike (403), usually because the connection predates the like permission (like.write). Reconnect X in Upload-Post and try again.

429.description: X only: error_code `x_daily_write_limit`: the X account used its daily replies, edits, reposts and likes through Upload-Post (by default 20 on the free plan, 200 on paid plans). `retry_after` and the `Retry-After` header say when it resets (00:00 UTC).

post.description: Re-enqueue an upload that failed on one or more platforms. Only failed platforms are retried; the original media snapshot is reused, so no re-upload is needed. Provide request_id or job_id.

request_id.description: The request_id returned by the original async upload. Provide request_id or job_id.

job_id.description: The scheduled job ID. Alternative to request_id.

400.description: Neither request_id nor job_id provided.

404.description: No upload found for the given identifier.

409.description: Nothing to retry (no failed platforms).

post.description: Delete a post already published to a platform. Supported: facebook, youtube, x, linkedin, pinterest, bluesky, google_business and telegram. TikTok does NOT support deletion via API and returns a clear error. Threads is not generally available yet: off by default (400 `platform_not_supported`); with the feature on, DELETE /{threads-media-id} needs the `threads_delete` permission on the connection (403 `threads_reconnect_required` otherwise) and Threads allows 100 deletes per account and 24 h (429 `threads_rate_limited`). Meta does not document whether deleting a repost id undoes the repost. Instagram is not generally available yet either (until then a clear error, and `instagram` is not in the `platform` list): it will work only with Instagram connections made through Meta's newer login; an older connection answers 400 `instagram_reconnect_required` with `connect_url`. Posts, Reels, Stories and whole carousels (not single carousel items or ads: 400 `instagram_media_not_deletable`).

platform.description: Platform to delete from. `threads` is not generally available yet (see the description). Instagram is not in the list until its deletion is generally available; TikTok does not support it.

delete_all_messages.description: Telegram: delete every message of the post (album items, caption rest, first comment, text sent before a location...), not only post_id. Only in the chat the profile is connected to, within 48 hours. Default false. The answer lists requested_message_ids.

user.description: Profile username as configured in Upload-Post.

post_id.description: The published post's ID on the target platform.

400.description: Missing fields or an unsupported platform (e.g. instagram, tiktok).

403.description: Not authorized to delete the post.

404.description: No post found for the given post_id.

post.description: Send a private reply (DM) to the author of a comment on your Instagram post. The comment must be less than 7 days old.

user.description: Profile username as configured in Upload-Post.

comment_id.description: ID of the comment to reply to (from Get Post Comments).

buttons.description: Up to 3 web_url buttons rendered in the Instagram DM.

400.description: Missing fields or invalid account.

429.description: Daily DM limit exceeded.

get.description: Retrieve the DM conversations of the account connected to the profile, including participants and recent messages. Bluesky (platform=bluesky) needs an app password created with access to direct messages (403 bluesky_dm_scope_missing otherwise), returns at most 25 conversations per page and adds status, unread_count, muted, kind, account and per-message direction, type, attachments, reactions and reply_to. Bluesky also takes kind, lock_status, view (summary: up to 100 per page; requests: experimental) and include (unread_counts, members); group conversations add a group block. Anything Bluesky marks as under development answers with experimental: true (403 bluesky_dm_experimental_disabled while not enabled). Telegram (platform=telegram) lists only the private chats of your own bot, and needs the bot's updates turned on with POST /uploadposts/telegram/updates (409 telegram_updates_not_enabled while they are off for that bot). X (not generally available yet; until then platform=x answers as before): the last 30 days of classic X direct messages, grouped by conversation (participant_id filters by the numeric X id). X bills $0.010 per message event read: Upload-Post keeps a copy per account, asks X at most every 5 minutes and only for what is new; include_users=true adds names and pictures ($0.010 per user); cursor=older reads one older page. The answer carries a billing estimate. Errors as the X endpoints: `x_reconnect_required` (dm.read), `x_daily_read_budget`, `x_read_plan_required`.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: 'instagram', 'bluesky', 'telegram' (Telegram needs the bot's updates turned on) or 'whatsapp' (stored conversations of the connected number).

parameters.name: business_connection_id
parameters.description: Telegram: the inbox of a connected Business account.

parameters.name: include_profile_photos
parameters.description: Telegram: add profile_pic_media_id to each contact.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Profile username as configured in Upload-Post.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Conversations per page (Bluesky: at most 25; higher values are lowered).

parameters.name: participant_id
parameters.description: Only your conversation with this person (Instagram: IGSID; Bluesky: handle or DID).

parameters.name: messages_cursor
parameters.description: Bluesky, with conversation_id: older messages of that conversation.

parameters.name: messages_before
parameters.description: WhatsApp: Unix ms; only messages older than this (use messages.paging.before of the previous page, with participant_id, to scroll back through one chat). Each WhatsApp conversation also returns unread_count: inbound messages after the last reply and the last mark_read.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Bluesky: message requests only, or accepted conversations only.

parameters.name: read_state
parameters.description: Bluesky: only conversations with unread messages.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Bluesky: only direct or group conversations.

parameters.name: lock_status
parameters.description: Bluesky: only conversations with this lock status (groups).

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Bluesky: 'summary' lists up to 100 conversations with only their latest message; 'requests' (experimental) lists incoming message requests and your pending group join requests, up to 100.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Bluesky, comma-separated: 'unread_counts' adds unread_counts {accepted, request}; 'members' (with conversation_id) adds every member of that conversation.

parameters.name: members_limit
parameters.description: Bluesky, with include=members: members per page (1-100, default 50).

parameters.name: members_cursor
parameters.description: Bluesky, with include=members: paging.next_cursor of the previous members page.

parameters.name: include_users
parameters.description: X: expand sender and participant profiles (billed by X per user).

400.description: Missing or invalid parameters.

403.description: Bluesky: error_code bluesky_dm_scope_missing (app password without DM access).

post.summary: Send a DM (Instagram, Bluesky, Telegram, WhatsApp)
post.description: Instagram: send a direct message to a user by IGSID; the recipient must have messaged your account first (24-hour messaging window policy enforced by Meta). Bluesky: recipient_id is a handle, DID or bsky.app profile link (or pass conversation_id); text up to 1000 characters (400 bluesky_message_too_long), up to 10 @handle mentions linked, one shared Bluesky post as attachment, reply_to, and sender_action (mark_seen, react, unreact, delete, accept, mute, unmute, leave). Buttons and templates are refused with 400. 504 bluesky_send_unconfirmed means the DM may have gone out: read the conversation before sending again. Telegram (your own bot): recipient_id is the numeric chat id; text up to 4096 characters, attachments by url or media_id (file_id), inline buttons (url or callback_data), reply_to, location, contact, business_connection_id (send as your Business account), checklist (Business), and sender_action (typing and the other chat actions, react, unreact, delete, mark_read and edit_checklist in Business chats). 403 telegram_recipient_not_started / telegram_recipient_blocked; 504 telegram_send_unconfirmed: it may have been sent. WhatsApp (the number connected to the profile, Cloud API): recipient_id is the phone number in international format (34600111222), or the business-scoped user id (BSUID, e.g. US.13491208655302741918) of a user who only came with one (sender.id of dm_received); authentication templates cannot go to a BSUID (whatsapp_bsuid_not_supported. Free text only inside the 24-hour customer service window (the customer's last message); outside it send an approved template (400 whatsapp_template_required). Also attachments (url or media_id from POST /dms/media; one image/video/document takes message as its caption), location, contacts, interactive buttons / list / cta_url (with message as the body, optional header and footer), reaction (with message_id; an empty emoji removes it) and sender_action mark_read / typing_on (blue ticks on message_id; sent together with a message it marks and then sends). Reactions and read receipts do not use the DM quota. Meta bills conversations to your WhatsApp Business account. X (not generally available yet; until then platform=x answers as before): classic X direct messages. recipient_id is the numeric X user id, or conversation_id, or participant_ids (2-49 numeric ids) to start a group; message and/or attachments [{"media_id": "<X media id>"}] (one); sender_action delete + message_id deletes a message for the account. Needs the X permissions dm.read and dm.write (403 x_reconnect_required until the account reconnects). X bills $0.015 per message and allows 15 per 15 min per account and 1,440 a day for all Upload-Post customers together (429 x_dm_app_daily_limit). Encrypted X Chat conversations are not reachable through this API.

user.description: Profile username as configured in Upload-Post.

recipient_id.description: Instagram: IGSID of the recipient. Bluesky: handle, DID or bsky.app profile link. Required unless conversation_id is sent (Bluesky). Telegram: numeric chat id of a person (sender.id of dm_received); groups and channels are refused (telegram_private_chats_only). WhatsApp: phone number in international format, digits only (34600111222), or the user's BSUID (US.13491208655302741918) when there is no phone.

message.description: The text message to send. Required unless a Bluesky post is shared or a sender_action is sent. Bluesky: up to 1000 characters. WhatsApp: up to 4096 characters.

conversation_id.description: Bluesky: send to this conversation (also group conversations).

attachments.description: Bluesky: one post to share, {"type": "post", "url": "https://bsky.app/profile/<handle>/post/<id>"} or {"type": "post", "uri": "at://..."}. Experimental: a group invitation {"type": "join_link", "code": "..."}. WhatsApp: up to 10 of {"type": "image|video|audio|document|sticker", "url": "https://..." or "media_id": "..."[, "caption", "filename"]}.

reply_to.description: Bluesky: id of a message in the same conversation to reply to. WhatsApp: id of the message to quote.

sender_action.description: Bluesky: mark_seen (mark_read), mark_all_read (every conversation; only without recipient_id / conversation_id / message; optional status), react, unreact, delete, accept, mute, unmute or leave. Does not consume the daily DM quota. WhatsApp: mark_read or typing_on (both need message_id, the inbound message; with a message, attachments or template it marks first and then sends).

message_id.description: Bluesky: message the sender_action applies to (required for react, unreact, delete). WhatsApp: the inbound message to mark as read, or to react to with reaction.

reaction.description: Bluesky: a single emoji for react / unreact (default ❤️). WhatsApp: an emoji with message_id, or {"message_id", "emoji"}; an empty emoji ("") removes your reaction.

business_connection_id.description: Telegram: send on behalf of the connected Telegram Business account.

location.description: Telegram: {latitude, longitude[, title, address]} (with title and address it is a venue). WhatsApp: {latitude, longitude[, name, address]}.

message_ids.description: Telegram: sender_action delete for up to 100 messages.

buttons.description: Instagram: up to 3 web_url buttons {title, url}. WhatsApp: up to 3 reply buttons {title[, id]} (needs message, the body).

status.description: Bluesky, with sender_action=mark_all_read: only those conversations.

idempotency_key.description: Bluesky, required with messages: repeating a request with the same key returns the first answer and sends nothing again.

messages.description: Bluesky (not generally available yet: 403 bluesky_dm_batch_disabled): up to 25 DMs in one request, to existing conversations only (conversation_id). Requires idempotency_key; one batch per minute per profile; a lookup budget as large as the batch (25: one per distinct conversation, one per distinct @mention, 2 per shared post); no identical message twice to the same conversation. Each sent message counts as one DM. The response has sent, unconfirmed, failed and results[] in order; unconfirmed items come in a 200 with retryable: false.

template.description: WhatsApp: an approved template {name, language, components} (works outside the 24-hour window).

contacts.description: WhatsApp: contact cards, each {name (string or {formatted_name}), phones, ...}.

list.description: WhatsApp: list message {button, sections: [{title, rows: [{id, title, description}]}]} (up to 10 rows, needs message).

header.description: WhatsApp: header text of an interactive message.

footer.description: WhatsApp: footer text of an interactive message.

typing.description: WhatsApp, with sender_action=mark_read: also show typing…

flow.description: Not generally available yet (ignored until it is turned on). WhatsApp: send a Flow (message = body). flow_id or flow_name, cta (30 chars), optional flow_token, mode (published|draft), flow_action (navigate|data_exchange), screen, data (object).

location_request.description: Not generally available yet (ignored until it is turned on). WhatsApp: ask the user to share their location (message = body, 1024 chars). The reply comes as a location message.

carousel.description: Not generally available yet (ignored until it is turned on). WhatsApp media carousel (message = body). Each card: media_url (https), media_type image|video, optional body (160 chars), and cta_url {display_text, url} or buttons (quick replies); all cards with the same kind and number of buttons.

call_button.description: Not generally available yet (ignored until it is turned on). WhatsApp call button (needs the Calling API on the number): display_text (20), ttl_minutes (1-43200), payload (512).

participant_ids.description: X: numeric user ids to start a group conversation.

sender_action_result.description: WhatsApp: result of the read receipt sent with the message.

get.description: Forwards one allow-listed, read-only Bluesky method and returns Bluesky's JSON untouched in `data`. `data` is Bluesky's raw shape: if Bluesky changes its lexicon, it changes. Pass the method's own query parameters with Bluesky's names (camelCase, e.g. includePins, parentHeight); arrays by repeating the parameter or comma-separated. A parameter the method does not have answers 400 bluesky_invalid_parameter (unknown_parameters); a method outside the list answers 400 bluesky_method_not_allowed (allowed_methods). Public methods need no `user` and do not use the account's session: app.bsky.actor.getProfile, app.bsky.actor.getProfiles, app.bsky.actor.searchActors, app.bsky.actor.searchActorsTypeahead, app.bsky.feed.getActorFeeds, app.bsky.feed.getAuthorFeed, app.bsky.feed.getFeed, app.bsky.feed.getFeedGenerator, app.bsky.feed.getFeedGenerators, app.bsky.feed.getLikes, app.bsky.feed.getListFeed, app.bsky.feed.getPostThread, app.bsky.feed.getPosts, app.bsky.feed.getQuotes, app.bsky.feed.getRepostedBy, app.bsky.graph.getActorStarterPacks, app.bsky.graph.getFollowers, app.bsky.graph.getFollows, app.bsky.graph.getList, app.bsky.graph.getLists, app.bsky.graph.getRelationships, app.bsky.graph.getStarterPack, app.bsky.graph.getStarterPacks, app.bsky.graph.getSuggestedFollowsByActor, app.bsky.graph.searchStarterPacks, app.bsky.graph.searchStarterPacksV2, app.bsky.labeler.getServices. Account methods need `user`: app.bsky.embed.getEmbedExternalView, app.bsky.feed.searchPosts, app.bsky.feed.searchPostsV2, app.bsky.graph.getListsWithMembership, app.bsky.graph.getStarterPacksWithMembership. 15 methods read the account's private data and are not enabled on the gateway (403 bluesky_private_read_disabled): app.bsky.actor.getPreferences, app.bsky.actor.getSuggestions, app.bsky.bookmark.getBookmarks, app.bsky.feed.getActorLikes, app.bsky.feed.getTimeline, app.bsky.feed.getSuggestedFeeds, app.bsky.graph.getBlocks, app.bsky.graph.getMutes, app.bsky.graph.getListBlocks, app.bsky.graph.getListMutes, app.bsky.graph.getKnownFollowers, app.bsky.notification.getPreferences, app.bsky.notification.getUnreadCount, app.bsky.notification.listActivitySubscriptions, app.bsky.notification.listNotifications; notifications have their own /uploadposts/bluesky/notifications* endpoints and known followers /uploadposts/bluesky/followers?known=true. 47 methods in total. The birth date is never returned. With `user` and no `actor`, getProfile, getAuthorFeed, getActorFeeds, getActorStarterPacks, getFollowers, getFollows, getLists, getRelationships and getSuggestedFollowsByActor read the profile's own account. Post URIs (uri, uris) accept at:// or a bsky.app post link. limit 1-100 where Bluesky accepts it. Not available on purpose: writes, app.bsky.unspecced.*, getGroupedNotifications, chat.bsky.* (use /uploadposts/dms/*), com.atproto.*, tools.ozone.*. Successful answers are cached 60 s (notifications 30 s) on the validated parameters; public reads are shared, account reads cached per account.

get.summary: Run a YouTube Analytics channel report
get.description: Not generally available yet: answers 503 youtube_analytics_disabled until it is enabled. reports.query for the profile's channel with any dimensions, metrics, filters and sort of YouTube's channel reports. Validated against the official report tables before it reaches YouTube (invalid combinations: 400 youtube_analytics_unsupported_query with hints, nothing spent). Revenue and ad metrics are not available. Answers are cached (12 h; 7 days for ranges that ended more than 5 days ago). Each uncached call counts 1 request of the account's daily Analytics allowance. Data has a 48-72 h delay.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Profile username with a YouTube channel connected.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: dimension==value joined with ';' (video/playlist accept up to 500 comma-separated IDs).

200.description: report, report_name, query, column_headers, rows, cached, cached_at, expires_at, data_note

400.description: Invalid request (stable error_code).

401.description: youtube_reauth_required

**Not generally available yet.** While webhook subscriptions are switched off for your account every route of this group answers `503` with `reason: webhook_subscriptions_disabled`.

Adds a destination that receives the listed events, besides the account webhook. Idempotent: the same url + events + profile_username returns the existing subscription (200, `created: false`) and reactivates it if it was disabled (`reactivated: true`); `name` and `source` are updated when sent. At most 10 active subscriptions per account. Team members (X-Act-As-User) cannot create them.

Deliveries carry the same body as the account webhook for that event and the same signature headers (`X-Upload-Post-Signature: sha256=HMAC(webhook_secret, "{timestamp}.{raw_body}")`, `X-Upload-Post-Timestamp`, `X-Upload-Post-Event`, `X-Upload-Post-Delivery`, `X-Upload-Post-Attempt`) plus `X-Upload-Post-Subscription: <id>`. The secret is the account webhook secret (`GET /uploadposts/users/notifications` → `notifications.webhook_secret`; created on the first subscription if missing). The first delivery can take up to about a minute; failed deliveries follow the retry schedule and appear in `GET /uploadposts/webhooks/deliveries?subscription_id=`.

429.description:
Too many requests: wait `details.retry_after` seconds (also in the `Retry-After` header) before calling again. code: `meta_rate_limited` (Meta is throttling this ad account, 60-3600 s: Upload-Post does not call Meta for that account until then, but still answers reads it has cached), `daily_limit_reached` (Upload-Post's daily limit; no `retry_after`, the message says when it resets).
Every call costs Meta rate-limit points (the development access tier blocks an ad account for about 5 minutes after a short burst): reads are cached for a short time and every write clears that account's cache.

post.summary: Promote an existing Facebook or Instagram post
post.description: Turns a published post into an ad in one call: campaign, ad set (budget, schedule, targeting), creative made from the post, and ad. Everything is validated before calling Meta and the post's eligibility is read first (code: `post_not_boostable`, `instagram_not_linked`). If a step fails, the campaign already created is deleted again (`details.rolled_back`). The ad spend is charged by Meta to the customer's ad account; Upload-Post charges nothing for it. Boosting to an EU audience needs `dsa_beneficiary` and `dsa_payor` (or defaults saved on the ad account), else 400 `dsa_information_required` and the campaign is rolled back.

post_id.description: Facebook: `<PAGE_ID>_<POST_ID>` (or the post id plus `page_id`). Instagram: the media id.

page_id.description: Required for Instagram: the Facebook Page linked to the Instagram account.

goal.description: engagement = OUTCOME_ENGAGEMENT/POST_ENGAGEMENT, video_views = THRUPLAY, traffic = OUTCOME_TRAFFIC/LINK_CLICKS, awareness = OUTCOME_AWARENESS/REACH.

amount.description: In the ad account currency (its decimals: none for JPY, KRW...).

currency.description: Optional check: must be the ad account currency.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD (ad account time zone) or `start_time` ISO-8601. Default: now.

end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD (end of that day) or `end_time` ISO-8601. Required with a lifetime budget; a daily budget needs at least 24 h.

link_url.description: Instagram only; required with goal `traffic`. A Facebook post keeps its own link.

special_ad_categories.description: Required by Meta when the ad is about one of them.

dry_run.description: Validate and read the post's eligibility, write nothing; returns the plan.

idempotency_key.description: Optional, 1-128 chars: a second request with the same key within 10 minutes is refused (409 `duplicate_request`).

dsa_beneficiary.description: The person or organisation the ads promote. EU Digital Services Act: required by Meta on ad sets whose audience includes the EU (with `dsa_payor`). If omitted, Meta uses the ad account's saved default (`dsa_defaults` in GET /uploadposts/ads/meta/account); it never copies one field into the other. Ignored by Meta outside the EU.

200.description: With `"dry_run": true`: validated and the post checked, nothing written.

eligibility.description: What Meta said about the post (`checked`, `permalink`, ...).

plan.description: What would be sent to Meta: `campaign`, `adset`, `creative`, `ad`, `budget`, ...

post.description: The promoted post (Facebook `<PAGE_ID>_<POST_ID>`, Instagram media id).

429.description:
Too many requests: wait `details.retry_after` seconds (also in the `Retry-After` header) before calling again. code: `meta_rate_limited` (Meta is throttling this ad account, 60-3600 s: Upload-Post does not call Meta for that account until then, but still answers reads it has cached), `daily_limit_reached` (Upload-Post's daily limit; no `retry_after`, the message says when it resets).

Posts that @mention the X account of the profile (not only replies to one post), newest first, with the author's `verified`, `verified_type` (blue, business, government, none) and `followers_count`. `verified: true` includes any paid X Premium account: use `verified_type` to tell organisations and governments apart.

Cost: X bills each mention returned ($0.005) and each author ($0.010). Upload-Post keeps a copy per X account and only asks X for mentions newer than the newest one it holds (at most once a minute; calls in between are served from the copy and cost nothing). Older pages use `next_cursor`. The filters (`verified_only`, `verified_type`, `min_followers`, `replies`) are applied by Upload-Post on the `limit` mentions scanned: they do not lower the cost, and a filtered page can hold fewer than `limit` items (keep paging with `next_cursor`). X rate limit: 300 requests / 15 min per account.

One read-only X API call per request, with the fields fixed by Upload-Post. `data`, `includes` and `meta` are X's own objects. Answers are cached for a few minutes per account (trends 15 min, analytics 1 h): repeating the call within that time costs nothing (`cached: true`). get.description:
**Not generally available yet: answers `503` `pinterest_feature_disabled` until it is turned on.**

Calls Pinterest API v5 with the connection of profile `user`: `{endpoint}` is the path of Pinterest's own reference (developers.pinterest.com/docs/api/v5) without the leading slash, with the same query parameters and JSON body. Reads are cached per account (analytics, trends and terms 1 h, the rest 60 s; `refresh=true` skips the cache) and count against a daily read limit per Upload-Post account; a write through this route drops the cached reads of the account. Deletes need `confirm=true`. Following users has a daily limit per Pinterest account. An operation that needs a Pinterest permission the connection did not grant answers `403` `pinterest_reconnect_required` (reconnect Pinterest) or `pinterest_scope_not_enabled` (Upload-Post does not ask for it yet), with `missing_scopes`, without calling Pinterest.

The post is identified by `post_auth_code` (generated by the post owner in the TikTok app: post → Ad settings → Ad authorization, valid 7-365 days) or, for a post of your own TikTok account connected to the profile, by `post_id` (Upload-Post generates the code; needs the Spark Ads permission on that TikTok connection). The campaign is created paused and only switched on at the end when `status` is `active`, so a half-built boost never spends. If a later step fails, the error lists in `details.created` what already exists (paused). Goals: `reach` (REACH/CPM), `video_views` (ENGAGED_VIEW/CPV), `traffic` (CLICK/CPC, needs `landing_page_url`), `followers` (ENGAGEMENT/FOLLOWERS). Spend runs on your TikTok ad account.

amount.description: In the ad account currency. TikTok enforces its own minimums.

type.description: `lifetime` needs `schedule.end_date`. `dynamic_daily` is allowlist-only at TikTok for reach, video_views and followers.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD (UTC) or ISO 8601 date-time. Default: now.

get.summary: List the reactions on a LinkedIn post or comment, with totals per reaction type
get.description:
**Not generally available yet: answers `503` `linkedin_feature_disabled` until it is turned on.**

Who reacted to a post (or to one of its comments with `comment_id`), one page at a time, plus `summary`: totals per reaction type (LIKE, PRAISE, EMPATHY, INTEREST, APPRECIATION, ENTERTAINMENT), comments and `comments_state` (OPEN or CLOSED), from LinkedIn's Reactions and Social Metadata APIs. `reaction_type` keeps only that type in the returned page (the totals stay whole). LinkedIn only lets a Page read the reactions on its own posts: on a personal profile's post it answers `403` `linkedin_permission_denied`. Answers are cached for a few minutes (`refresh=true` skips it) and each fresh answer counts two reads against a daily limit of LinkedIn reads per Upload-Post account.

parameters.description: Numeric comment id or urn:li:comment:(…): the reactions on that comment instead of the post.

parameters.description: Page the request acts for (default: the profile's Page or the post's author).

get.summary: Analytics of a LinkedIn personal profile: post, all posts, video and followers
get.description:
**Not generally available yet: answers `503` `linkedin_feature_disabled` until it is turned on.**

Analytics LinkedIn gives to the member who connected the profile (Community Management API). `kind=post`: one post (`post_id`, the id our upload returned: LinkedIn does not let apps list a member's posts). `kind=posts`: all the member's posts together. `kind=video`: plays, viewers and watch time of one video post. `kind=followers`: lifetime followers, or the daily series with `aggregation=DAILY` or a date range.

Post metrics: IMPRESSION, MEMBERS_REACHED, RESHARE, REACTION, COMMENT, POST_SAVE, POST_SEND, LINK_CLICKS, PREMIUM_CTA_CLICKS, FOLLOWER_GAINED_FROM_CONTENT, PROFILE_VIEW_FROM_CONTENT (default: the first five). Video: VIDEO_PLAY, VIDEO_VIEWER, VIDEO_WATCH_TIME (milliseconds). LinkedIn has no DAILY values for MEMBERS_REACHED, LINK_CLICKS, FOLLOWER_GAINED_FROM_CONTENT, PROFILE_VIEW_FROM_CONTENT (nor IMPRESSION of one post), and no date range for VIDEO_VIEWER / VIDEO_WATCH_TIME: those combinations answer 400 before calling LinkedIn. `until` is exclusive. The connection must have granted LinkedIn's member analytics permissions (r_member_postAnalytics, r_member_profileAnalytics); otherwise `403` without calling LinkedIn. Each metric is one LinkedIn read, counted against a daily limit of LinkedIn reads per Upload-Post account; answers are cached for a few minutes (`refresh=true` skips it).

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Default: post with post_id, posts without.

parameters.name: post_id
parameters.description: Post urn (urn:li:share:… / urn:li:ugcPost:…), required for kind=post and kind=video.

400.description: Validation failed before calling Meta, or Meta rejected the request (Meta's reason in `meta_error`). code: `invalid_request`, `meta_ads_error`.

401.description: Invalid credentials, or the Meta sign-in expired or was revoked: code: `reauth_required` (connect again).

403.description: Meta Ads is not enabled for this account (code: `meta_ads_not_available`), Meta refused a permission (code: `meta_permission_denied`) or Meta would not let the Ads connection read the Facebook Page (code: `meta_page_permission_missing`: connect Meta Ads again, select that Page in Meta's dialog and keep its permissions).

404.description: No ad account connected, profile without a linked ad account, or the object is not in this ad account (code: `meta_not_found`).

429.description:
Too many requests: wait `details.retry_after` seconds (also in the `Retry-After` header) before calling again. code: `meta_rate_limited` (Meta is throttling this ad account, 60-3600 s: Upload-Post does not call Meta for that account until then, but still answers reads it has cached), `daily_limit_reached` (Upload-Post's daily limit; no `retry_after`, the message says when it resets).
Every call costs Meta rate-limit points (the development access tier blocks an ad account for about 5 minutes after a short burst): reads are cached for a short time and every write clears that account's cache.

502.description: Meta is unreachable or failed (code: `meta_unreachable`, `meta_temporary_error`). On a write, code: `write_outcome_unknown` = it may have been applied: check before retrying.

503.description: Meta Ads is switched off on this server (code: `meta_ads_disabled`).

BearerAuth.description: Profile JWT: the token of the access_url returned by POST /uploadposts/users/generate-jwt (white-label connect page). Accepted where an operation lists it: validate-jwt, the Connect API start, manual credentials, Page/location selection, disconnecting a social account and the end-client approval routes. It only acts on the profile it was issued for.

TikTokProfile.name: profile
TikTokProfile.description: Profile username. Must have a TikTok account connected.

TikTokMusicGenre.name: genre
TikTokMusicGenre.description: Commercial Music Library genre, e.g. `ALL`, `POP`, `HIP_HOP/RAP`, `R&B/SOUL`. The slashes and the ampersand are part of TikTok's enum. Unknown values fall back to `ALL`.

TikTokMusicCountry.name: country_code
TikTokMusicCountry.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country whose trending chart is read. The catalogue is per country, so this changes which tracks come back.

MetaAdsAccountId.name: ad_account_id
MetaAdsAccountId.description: Meta ad account to use (`act_123...` or the bare number). Without it: `X-Ads-Account-Id` header, then `ad_account_id` in the JSON body, then the only or the default connected account (several and no default = 400).

MetaAdsProfile.name: profile_username
MetaAdsProfile.description: Use the ad account linked to this profile, and only that one (404 if the profile has none linked; never falls back to the default account).

PlatformNotSupported.description: That network cannot answer this question yet. Upload-Post is one endpoint per QUESTION with a `platform`, so the message names the platforms that can. Branch on the error_code, not on a hard-coded platform list: when the network is added, the same call starts returning data. Some endpoints carry the text in `error` instead of `message`.

message.example: 'instagram' does not support audience insights yet. Supported: tiktok.

TikTokReconnectRequired.description: The profile has no TikTok connection able to serve this endpoint, or TikTok no longer accepts the connection's token (revoked or missing a permission; then `reauth_required: true` is included). Reconnecting the TikTok account from Manage Users enables it. Retrying without reconnecting does not help.

message.example: Profile 'my_profile' has no TikTok connection that supports this endpoint. Reconnect your TikTok account from Manage Users.

reauth_required.description: Present (true) when TikTok no longer accepts the connection's token.

TikTokReauthRequired.description: The TikTok token expired and could not be refreshed; the account must be reconnected.

message.example: Your TikTok session has expired. Please reconnect your TikTok account at app.upload-post.com/manage-users.

TikTokUpstreamError.description: TikTok failed the request. Its message is returned verbatim. A request TikTok refuses as invalid (error 40002) is a 400 with error_code `invalid_parameter` instead, and a revoked token a 400 `tiktok_reconnect_required`.

BadRequest.description: Bad Request — Missing or invalid parameters.

Forbidden.description: Forbidden — Plan restrictions or insufficient permissions.

NotFound.description: Not Found — Resource does not exist.

TooManyRequests.description: Too Many Requests — Monthly limit exceeded.

message.example: This upload would exceed your monthly limit.

UploadTooManyRequests.description: Too Many Requests — the monthly upload limit is exceeded, or (uploads with scheduled_date or add_to_queue) the account already has the maximum number of pending scheduled posts for its plan (`error_code: SCHEDULED_POSTS_LIMIT`).

message.example: This upload would exceed your monthly limit.

error_code.description: SCHEDULED_POSTS_LIMIT when the pending scheduled posts cap was reached.

pending_scheduled_posts.description: Scheduled posts the account has waiting (SCHEDULED_POSTS_LIMIT only).

max_pending_scheduled_posts.description: Maximum pending scheduled posts for the account's plan (SCHEDULED_POSTS_LIMIT only).

ScheduledPostsLimit.description: Too Many Requests — the account already has the maximum number of pending scheduled posts for its plan. Only posts due more than 15 minutes ahead count. Wait for some to publish or cancel scheduled posts, then try again.

TikTokMusicTrack.description: One track of TikTok's Commercial Music Library.

id.description: Send this as `tiktok_music_id` on an upload. NOT `commercial_music_id`: TikTok rejects that one on public posts.

commercial_music_id.description: TikTok's catalogue id for the same track. Returned for reference only.

rank.description: Position in TikTok's trending chart for the requested filters.

TikTokLocation.description: One TikTok place. Both fields must be sent together on an upload.

location_id.description: Send as `tiktok_location_id`.

location_name.description: Send as `tiktok_location_name`. TikTok rejects the id without it.

location_address.description: Postal address, useful for disambiguating results in a picker.
location_address.example: C. de Ruiz de Alarcon, 23, 28014 Madrid, Spain

TikTokPostMode.description: [TikTok] DIRECT_POST publishes immediately. MEDIA_UPLOAD sends to TikTok drafts (same as tiktok_upload_to_draft=true). Either field works on any TikTok account.

InstagramPhotoMediaType.description: [Instagram] Type of photo media. Automatically handles CAROUSEL/REELS logic if mixed media is detected.

InstagramShareMode.description: [Instagram] Reel posting mode. CUSTOM = regular Reel. Trial Reel modes test content with non-followers first.

LinkedInVisibility.description: [LinkedIn] Visibility setting for the post. Required when platform includes linkedin.

XReplySettings.description: [X] Controls who can reply to the tweet.

FFmpegJobStatus.description: Status of an FFmpeg processing job.

changes.description: List of transformations applied to the media.

results.description: Per-platform results keyed by platform name.

request_id.description: Use this to poll status via GET /uploadposts/status.

total_platforms.description: Number of platforms being uploaded to.

warnings.description: Non-fatal notices. TikTok: a warning that the public post ID will be added later when TikTok releases it after moderation.

post_id_resolved_late.description: TikTok: true when the real post ID and post_url were filled in after the upload finished (TikTok releases them once moderation ends, up to 24 hours later).
TikTok: true when platform_post_id and post_url were filled in after the upload finished (TikTok releases the post ID once moderation ends, up to 24 hours later).

job_id.description: Present when the upload originated from a scheduled job.

changes.description: List of transformations applied to the media (e.g., transcoding, aspect ratio changes).

prevalidation_metadata.description: Media metadata detected before upload (dimensions, codec, duration, etc.).

request_id_logs.description: Internal request ID for log correlation.

dashboard.description: Whether the upload was initiated from the dashboard.

job_id.description: Unique identifier of the scheduled job.

scheduled_date.description: ISO-8601 date/time when the post will go live (UTC).

preview_url.description: Short-lived signed URL to preview the media. Null for text posts.

slots_mode.description: auto = the queue fills the best hours from /uploadposts/best-times. Opt-in.

effective_slots.description: The slots the queue is filling now.

auto_slots_info.description: Auto mode: computed_at, timezone, count, status (ok, no_data_using_fixed_slots, refresh_failed_kept_previous, disabled_using_fixed_slots) and per-network source/confidence.

configured.description: true once queue settings were saved for this profile; false means queue_settings shows the defaults because the queue was never configured.

is_queue_slot.description: Whether this slot is a configured queue slot.

message.description: Present when no slots are available.

views.description: Total content views. For Instagram, this is the official 'views' metric (replaces deprecated 'impressions'). Same value as 'impressions' field.

impressions.description: Total impressions/views. For Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok this equals the 'views' field. Kept for backwards compatibility.

AnalyticsResponse.description: Analytics data keyed by platform name. Metrics vary by platform.

id.description: Facebook Page ID. Use this value as `facebook_page_id` in upload endpoints.

name.description: Display name of the Facebook page.

picture.description: URL of the page's profile picture.

account_id.description: Internal identifier for the user's connected Facebook account.

name.description: Display name of the LinkedIn page.

account_id.description: Internal identifier for the connected LinkedIn account.

vanityName.description: Custom vanity URL of the page.

username.description: Unique profile identifier. This is the `user` value of every API call; it never changes.

display_name.description: Label shown in the dashboard instead of the username; null when unset. Set it with PATCH /uploadposts/users/{username}. Not the same as social_accounts.<platform>.display_name.

reauth_required.description: Whether the account needs to be re-authenticated.

social_accounts.description: Connected social media accounts keyed by platform name.

client_approval.description: Only in GET /uploadposts/users/validate-jwt, while post approvals are on: true when this connection link may approve or reject the profile's pending posts (the link was generated with client_approval: true and the profile still has it on).

duration_seconds.description: Duration of the input media in seconds.

result.description: Present once the job has an output.

media_url.description: Temporary public signed URL of a copy of the output (video and image outputs only; audio outputs do not get one). No API key needed: pass it as video_url or photos[] to the upload endpoints. Poll the job again for a fresh signature; the copy is deleted 24 hours after the job finished.

media_url_expires_in_seconds.description: Lifetime of the media_url signature, in seconds.

media_url_note.description: Human-readable reminder of how to use media_url.

download_url.description: Authenticated download endpoint (GET /api/uploadposts/ffmpeg/jobs/{job_id}/download). Requires your API key; do not pass it as video_url.

ConnectionStatusPayload.description: Payload sent to your webhook URL when a social account connection status changes.

user_email.description: The email address of the account owner.

platform.description: The social platform (e.g., instagram, youtube, tiktok, x, linkedin, facebook, threads, pinterest, reddit, bluesky, google_business).

account_name.description: The account identifier on the platform.

profile_username.description: The Upload-Post profile associated with this account.

reason.description: Additional context for the status change (e.g., manual_disconnect, account_blocked, token_refresh_threshold_exceeded).

created_at.description: The timestamp of the event in ISO 8601 format.

WebhookPayload.description: Payload sent to your webhook URL when an upload completes.

error.description: timeout, connection_error or another short label when there was no HTTP answer

delivery_id.description: Same value as the X-Upload-Post-Delivery header; identical on every retry.

url.description: Webhook URL without its query string.

test.description: true for deliveries sent by POST /uploadposts/users/notifications/test (never retried).

last_error.description: Short error label, or why the delivery is waiting/closed: channel_paused, expired, webhook_removed, event_unsubscribed, blocked_url, retries_disabled.

redelivery_of.description: delivery_id of the original, on a manual redelivery.

payload.description: Exact body that was sent. In the list only with include_payload=true; always in the single-delivery and redeliver responses.

subscription_id.description: Webhook subscription that received it (target subscription).

message_cooldown_hours.description: Effective cooldown for story_reply, story_mention and dm_keyword: never below 24.

stats.description: successful_replies, failed_replies, skipped_cooldown, deferred, plus per-trigger <trigger>_triggers / <trigger>_replies and unknown_outcome once they count something.

hint.description: Plain-language hint when subscribed but no event arrived in the last 6 hours.

bluesky_error.description: Bluesky's own error name, when it gives one.

BlueskyAccount.description: id, handle, display_name, avatar and url always; the rest when Bluesky returns them.

CodedError.description: Error body with a stable machine-readable code. See the error code catalog in the docs.

code.description: Same value as error_code (team access errors only).

error.description: Human-readable message. Some errors carry it here and others in `message`; the 503 of a feature that is not available yet carries both.

WebhookSubscription.description: One extra webhook destination of the account (n8n trigger, REST hook...). Independent from the account webhook_url.

events.description: Event names this destination receives (sorted, unique).

profile_username.description: Only events of this profile; null = every profile of the account.

source.description: Free label of the integration that created it (a-z, 0-9, _ . -; max 40).

disabled_reason.description: Why Upload-Post stopped sending: the URL answered 404/410 repeatedly, it kept failing for days, it is not an allowed destination, or its profile was deleted. A disabled subscription stays listed for 30 days; create it again to re-enable it.

last_failure.description: Short label of the last failure (e.g. http_500, timeout, dns).

PostApproval.description: A post waiting for (or past) review. Created when an Editor (pending_approval) or a Contributor (draft) publishes.

version.description: Goes up by one on every edit; approve sends the version it reviewed.

immediate.description: Publish as soon as it is approved (no date of its own).

queued.description: Sent with add_to_queue: the queue slot is picked when it is approved.

decided_by.description: Email of the reviewer, or client:<profile> for the end client.

destinations_effective.description: Detail only: the Page actually used when publishing (the one pinned to the profile wins) and its name.

fields.description: Detail only: the platform options sent with the post.

preview_url.description: Short-lived signed URL (detail, and the first 50 items of a listing).

ActionError.description: Error of an action endpoint: a human `error` (or `message`) and, when there is one, a stable `error_code`.

post_metrics.description: Metric name -> value; keys depend on the platform (see available_metrics).

media_type.description: TikTok (not generally available yet): the media type TikTok reports for the post. Only when TikTok answers it.

engagement_likes.description: TikTok (not generally available yet): when the likes happened along the video, ordered by second. Only when TikTok answers it.

GbpError.description: Google Business error. `error_code` (same value in `code`) is stable; `error` is the message for people. Common codes on every endpoint: 401 `google_business_reconnect_required` (reconnect Google Business), 403 `google_business_permission_denied`, 429 `google_rate_limited` (with `retry_after_seconds`), 502 `google_unreachable` (safe to retry) and `google_result_unknown` (a write may have been applied: check before retrying), 503 `gbp_feature_disabled` (the action is temporarily switched off). The endpoints that existed first (locations, reviews list, reply and batch) may answer some errors with only `error` or `message`.

message.description: Message on some older endpoints instead of `error`.

outcome_unknown.description: Google did not confirm a write.

example.error: This Google Business account has several locations: pass location_id.

GbpEditStatus.description: Google's moderation stage of each edited field or attribute (experimental Google API). Stages: `PENDING`, `ACCEPTED`, `REJECTED` (see `rejection_reason`), `UPDATED_BY_GOOGLE`, `DRAFT`. If Google does not return it the edit still succeeds and the answer carries `warnings`.

GbpLocationInfoView.description: Flat, readable view of a Google Business location.

webhook_events.description: Which events the account webhook receives: an object {event: true|false} or a list of names; both are stored as sent and returned the same way. Omitted or empty = every event except the opt-in ones.

ChatgptAdsError.description: ChatGPT Ads error. There is no `error_code`: branch on the HTTP status; `message` carries the reason (OpenAI's own reason on a 400 it rejected).

details.description: Promote only: `{"created": {campaign_id, ad_group_id, ad_id}}` already created when a later step failed.

example.message: ChatGPT Ads rejected the stored API key. Issue a new one in Ads Manager (https://ads.openai.com → Settings → API keys) and reconnect the account.

ChatgptAdsAccount.description: A connected ChatGPT Ads account. The API key is never returned.

profiles.description: Profiles linked to this account (list; on connect only the one passed).

media_url.description: Signed URL to pass as the media URL of an upload (when uploaded and include_url).

WebhookEventName.description: Webhook event name (dots are accepted too: social_account.connected). youtube_video_* are accepted only while YouTube push is on, post_approval_* only while post approvals are on, linkedin_page_activity (likes, reshares, mentions, Page comments and comment edits/deletes on a subscribed LinkedIn Page: `action` reaction|repost|mention|page_comment|comment_edited|comment_deleted) only while it is on. dm_received, comment_received, telegram_update, the Google Business events, post_analytics_updated and the gated ones are opt-in: they are only sent if listed.

ClientPostApproval.description: A post waiting for approval as the end client sees it (connect page): never the author, who decided, or internal ids (author_email, author_role, decided_by, decided_by_role, request_id, external_id, job_id, fields are left out).

version.description: Goes up by one on every edit; approve sends the version it reviewed.

immediate.description: Publish as soon as it is approved (no date of its own).

queued.description: Sent with add_to_queue: the queue slot is picked when it is approved.

destinations_effective.description: Detail only: the Page actually used when publishing (the one pinned to the profile wins) and its name.

preview_url.description: Short-lived signed URL (detail, and the first 50 items of a listing).

MetaAdsError.description: Meta Ads error. Branch on `code`; `meta_error` carries Meta's own error when Meta answered.

details.description: `retry_after` (seconds) on 429 `meta_rate_limited` / `budget_change_limit`; `fields` on `dsa_information_required`; boost only: `created` (ids already created when a later step failed) and `rolled_back` (the campaign was deleted again).

example.message: Meta Ads is not available yet.

token_expires_at.description: When the Meta sign-in expires (~60 days for a user token; null = never).

MetaAdsTargeting.description: Checked before calling Meta. Special ad categories EMPLOYMENT, HOUSING, CREDIT and FINANCIAL_PRODUCTS_SERVICES allow neither gender nor ages other than 18-65.

advantage_audience.description: Let Meta widen the audience. With it, `age_min` must be 18-25 and `age_max` 65.

scope.description: X permission to grant by reconnecting (x_reconnect_required).

XBilling.description: What this call made X bill, at the official pay-per-use prices (estimate: X deduplicates a resource read twice in the same UTC day).

endpoint.description: Pinterest path template of the operation, e.g. `/boards/{board_id}`.

cached.description: Reads only: served from the cache.

data.description: Pinterest's JSON answer (`null` for an empty 204).

TiktokAdsError.description: TikTok Ads error. `code` is set when the reason is actionable; on a 400 TikTok rejected, `message` is TikTok's own and `details.tiktok_code` its return code.
